Scheme Grade_mut := Induction for Grade Sort Prop
  with CGrade_mut := Induction for CGrade Sort Prop.

Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi t, Grade P psi t -> GEq P psi t t.
Proof.
  intros P psi t H.
  apply (Grade_mut (fun P psi t d => GEq P psi t t)
                   (fun P psi phi0 t d => CEq P psi phi0 t t)).
  - intros. apply GEq_Type. assumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Var; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_Pi. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A b g IH c IHc.
    eapply GEq_Abs. intros x Hx. apply IH. exact Hx. exact IHc.
  - intros. eapply GEq_App; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_WSigma. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros. eapply GEq_WPair; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 a c g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_LetPair. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_SSigma. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros. eapply GEq_SPair; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Sum; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Case; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TyUnit; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TmUnit; eassumption.
  - intros P1 phi phi0 a Hle g IH. apply CEq_Leq; assumption.
  - intros. eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a,
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. destruct H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [ assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption ].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.

Ltac inv_grade_inj :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_Inj1 ?a) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac inv_grade_inj2 :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_Inj2 ?a) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac inv_grade_wpair :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_WPair ?a ?ps0 ?b) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac par_family :=
  intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; eauto.

Lemma Step_par : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hg Hstep. revert Hg.
  induction Hstep; intros Hg.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_App.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + apply CGrade_CPar_refl. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply CGrade_CPar_refl. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Case.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst. inv_grade_inj.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst. inv_grade_inj2.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta2.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Proj1.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Proj2.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_LetPair.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + par_family.
  - inversion Hg; subst. inv_grade_wpair.
    eapply Par_WPairBeta.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + par_family.
Qed.

Scheme GEq_mut := Induction for GEq Sort Prop
  with CEq_mut := Induction for CEq Sort Prop.

Lemma GEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), GEq P psi a b -> GEq P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  apply (GEq_mut (fun P psi a b d => GEq P psi b a)
                 (fun P psi phi0 a b d => CEq P psi phi0 b a)).
  all: try (intros; match goal with
            | |- CEq _ _ _ _ _ => first [ eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption | fail 1 ]
            | _ => fail 1
            end).
  all: try (intros; econstructor; eauto).
  all: try assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------- type-constructor tags ---------------- *)

Inductive ttag : Set :=
 | TType | TTyUnit | TPi | TWSigma | TSSigma | TSum.

Definition ctag (t:tm) : option ttag :=
  match t with
  | a_Type _ => Some TType
  | a_TyUnit => Some TTyUnit
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => Some TPi
  | a_WSigma _ _ _ => Some TWSigma
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => Some TSSigma
  | a_Sum _ _ => Some TSum
  | _ => None
  end.

Lemma Par_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht.
  - exact Ht.
  - eauto using Par_ctag.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.

Lemma Par_abs_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A a b,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) b ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' a', b = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\
    ((A' = A /\ a' = a) \/
     (CPar P psi q_Top A A' /\
      forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi0) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a b Hpar.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as t eqn:E.
  revert A a E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - (* Par_Refl *)
    exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, a0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - (* Par_Abs *)
    exists L, A2, b2. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

    uniq_nil : uniq nil
  | uniq_push : forall (x : AtomSetImpl.elt) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
                uniq E -> x `notin` dom E -> uniq (x ~ a ++ E).

Arguments uniq [A]%_type_scope _%_list_scope
Arguments uniq_nil A%_type_scope
Arguments uniq_push [A]%_type_scope [x] a [E]%_list_scope _ _
dom =
fix dom (C : Type) (E : list (atom * C)) {struct E} : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (x, _) :: E' => add x (dom C E')
  end
     : forall [C : Type], list (atom * C) -> atoms

Arguments dom [C]%_type_scope E%_list_scope
dom_map
     : forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (E : list (atom * A)),
       dom (map f E) [=] dom E
dom_app
     : forall (A : Type) (E F : list (atom * A)),
       dom (E ++ F) [=] union (dom E) (dom F)
dom_cons
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (b : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       dom ((x, b) :: E) [=] union (singleton x) (dom E)
dom_one

(* ---------------- updating the grade of a binding in an econtext ---------------- *)

Fixpoint upd (x:atom) (g:grade) (P:econtext) : econtext :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,h)::P' => (y, if eq_var x y then g else h) :: upd x g P'
  end.

Lemma upd_nil : forall x g, upd x g nil = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma upd_cons : forall x g y h (P:econtext),
  upd x g ((y,h)::P) = (y, if eq_var x y then g else h) :: upd x g P.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_upd : forall x g (P:econtext), dom (upd x g P) [=] dom P.
Proof.
  intros x g P. induction P as [|[y h] P IH]; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Equal_refl.
  - rewrite dom_cons, dom_cons, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_upd : forall x g (P:econtext), uniq P -> uniq (upd x g P).
Proof.
  intros x g P H. induction P as [|[y h] P IH]; simpl.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion H; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + rewrite dom_upd. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_upd_iff : forall x g (P:econtext) y h,
  uniq P ->
  binds y h (upd x g P) <->

Lemma Grade_lc_top : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext),
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) -> Grade P q_Top a.

Lemma CGrade_lc_top : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext) phi0,
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) -> CGrade P q_Top phi0 a.
Proof.
  intros a P phi0 Hlc Hu Hws.
  exact (proj2 (Grade_lc_top_aux a Hlc P phi0 Hu Hws)).

(* At annotation q_Top (the irrelevant grade), any well-scoped lc term is
   CGrade at any ambient grade. *)
Lemma CGrade_top_any : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext) phi,
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) ->
  CGrade P phi q_Top a.
Proof.
  intros a P phi Hlc Hu Hws.
  destruct (classic (q_Top <= phi)) as [Hle|Hnle].

    apply CG_Leq with (phi:=q_Top).
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + apply Grade_lc_top; assumption.
  - apply (CG_Nleq Hlc Hnle Hu).
Qed.
EOF

Inductive CEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
with GEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GEq_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GEq_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GEq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | GEq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->

    + eapply G_Pi. exact HA2.
      intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [HB1 HB2]. exact HB2.

    destruct IHc as [CA1 CA2]. split.
    + eapply G_Abs.
      intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb1.
      exact CA1.
    + eapply G_Abs.
      intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb2.
      exact CA2.
  - (* GEq_App *) intros P1 psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 g IHg c IHc.
    destruct IHg as [Gb1 Gb2]. destruct IHc as [Ca1 Ca2]. split.
    + eapply G_App; [exact Gb1 | exact Ca1].
    + eapply G_App; [exact Gb2 | exact Ca2].

    destruct IHg as [HA1 HA2]. split.
    + eapply G_WSigma. exact HA1.
      intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [HB1 HB2]. exact HB1.
    + eapply G_WSigma. exact HA2.
      intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [HB1 HB2]. exact HB2.

    destruct IHc as [Ca1 Ca2]. destruct IHg as [Gb1 Gb2]. split.
    + eapply G_WPair; [exact Ca1 | exact Gb1].

    + eapply G_SSigma. exact HA1.

Proof. intros; exact (proj2 GEq_CEq_grade P psi phi0 a b H). Qed.

 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->

     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->

     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a

     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c

(* ---------------- key lists: uniq vs NoDup ---------------- *)

Fixpoint keys (E:econtext) : list atom :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (x,_)::E' => x :: keys E'
  end.

Lemma keys_app : forall (C Q:econtext), keys (C ++ Q) = keys C ++ keys Q.
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[x g] C IH]; intros Q; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma In_keys : forall (E:econtext) x, In x (keys E) <-> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|[y g] E IH]; intros x; simpl.
  - split; intro H.
    + inversion H.
    + apply empty_iff in H; destruct H.
  - split; intro H.
    + destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * apply AtomSetImpl.FM.add_iff. left. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.FM.add_iff. right. apply (proj1 (IH x)); exact Hin.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.FM.add_iff in H. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
      * left. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * right. apply (proj2 (IH x)); exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_NoDup_keys : forall (E:econtext), uniq E <-> NoDup (keys E).
Proof.
  intro E. induction E as [|[x g] E IH].
  - simpl. split; intros H.
    + apply NoDup_nil.
    + apply uniq_nil.
  - simpl. split; intros H.
    + inversion H as [|? ? ? Ht Hnot]; subst.
      apply NoDup_cons.
      * intro Hin. apply Hnot. apply (proj1 (In_keys E x)); exact Hin.
      * apply (proj1 IH); exact Ht.
    + apply NoDup_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [Hnot Hnd].
      apply uniq_cons.
      * apply (proj2 IH); exact Hnd.
      * intro Hin. apply Hnot. apply (proj2 (In_keys E x)); exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma binds_swap_mid : forall (C:econtext) x gx y gy (P:econtext) z gz,
  binds z gz (C ++ (x,gx)::(y,gy)::P) -> binds z gz (C ++ (y,gy)::(x,gx)::P).
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[w gw] C IH]; intros x gx y gy P z gz H; simpl in *.
  - destruct H as [Heq|[Heq|Hin]].
    + right. left. exact Heq.
    + left. exact Heq.
    + right. right. exact Hin.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. exact Heq.
    + right. eapply IH; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma keys_swap_mid : forall (C:econtext) x gx y gy (P:econtext),

  - apply Permutation_refl.

(* ---------------- Grade/CGrade invariant under swapping two binders ---------------- *)

Lemma Grade_swap_mid : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall (C:econtext) dx dgx dy dgy (Q:econtext),
    P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::(dy,dgy)::Q ->
    Grade (C ++ (dy,dgy)::(dx,dgx)::Q) psi a.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi a (_:Grade P psi a) =>
       forall (C:econtext) dx dgx dy dgy (Q:econtext),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::(dy,dgy)::Q ->
         Grade (C ++ (dy,dgy)::(dx,dgx)::Q) psi a)
    (fun P psi phi0 a (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) =>
       forall (C:econtext) dx dgx dy dgy (Q:econtext),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::(dy,dgy)::Q ->
         CGrade (C ++ (dy,dgy)::(dx,dgx)::Q) psi phi0 a)).
  - (* G_Var *) intros P psi x psi0 u i b C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_Var.
    + apply uniq_swap_mid; exact u.
    + exact i.
    + apply binds_swap_mid; exact b.
  - (* G_Type *) intros P psi s u C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    apply G_Type. apply uniq_swap_mid; exact u.
  - (* G_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_Pi.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + intros z nz. apply (IHfam z nz ((z,psi)::C) dx dgx dy dgy Q). reflexivity.
  - (* G_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A b g0 IHfam c IHc C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_Abs.
    + intros z nz. apply (IHfam z nz ((z,psi0)::C) dx dgx dy dgy Q). reflexivity.
    + apply IHc; reflexivity.
  - (* G_App *) intros P psi b psi0 a g IHg c IHc C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_App.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + apply IHc; reflexivity.
  - (* G_WSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_WSigma.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + intros z nz. apply (IHfam z nz ((z,psi)::C) dx dgx dy dgy Q). reflexivity.
  - (* G_WPair *) intros P psi a psi0 b c IHc g IHg C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_WPair.
    + apply IHc; reflexivity.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
  - (* G_LetPair *) intros L P psi psi0 a b g IHg g0 IHfam C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_LetPair.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + intros z nz. apply (IHfam z nz ((z,psi0)::C) dx dgx dy dgy Q). reflexivity.
  - (* G_SSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_SSigma.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + intros z nz. apply (IHfam z nz ((z,psi)::C) dx dgx dy dgy Q). reflexivity.
  - (* G_SPair *) intros P psi a psi0 b c IHc g IHg C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_SPair.
    + apply IHc; reflexivity.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
  - (* G_Proj1 *) intros P psi psi0 a g IHg i C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_Proj1.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + exact i.
  - (* G_Proj2 *) intros P psi psi0 a g IHg C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    apply G_Proj2. apply IHg; reflexivity.
  - (* G_Sum *) intros P psi A B g IHg g0 IHg0 C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    eapply G_Sum.
    + apply IHg; reflexivity.
    + apply IHg0; reflexivity.
  - (* G_Inj1 *) intros P psi a g IHg C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    apply G_Inj1. apply IHg; reflexivity.
  - (* G_Inj2 *) intros P psi a g IHg C dx dgx dy dgy Q Heq. subst P.
    apply G_Inj2. apply IHg; reflexivity.

(* ---------------- Grade/CGrade under substitution for an inserted binder ---------------- *)

Lemma Grade_subst_mid : forall (P:econtext) psi (t:tm), Grade P psi t ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) dx dgx (s:tm),
    P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi s ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx t).

  intros PP ps0 t0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi t (_:Grade P psi t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (dx:atom) (dgx:grade) (s:tm),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q -> Grade (C ++ Q) psi s ->
         Grade (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx t))
    (fun P psi phi0 t (_:CGrade P psi phi0 t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (dx:atom) (dgx:grade) (s:tm),

         assert (Hs' : Grade ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi s).

         assert (GBz : Grade ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))).

(* ---------------- opening a Grade derivation along an argument ---------------- *)

Lemma Grade_open_rec : forall (k:nat) (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  Grade Q psi s ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b)) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k s b).
Proof.
  intros k Q psi psi0 b L s Hs Hfam.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm b)) as [x Hx].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxfv].
  assert (Hbody : Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b)).
  { apply Hfam; exact HxL. }
  assert (Hres : Grade Q psi (subst_tm_tm s x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b))).
  { apply (@Grade_subst_mid ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) Hbody
             nil Q x psi0 s).
    - reflexivity.
    - exact Hs. }
  rewrite (@subst_open_rec b x s k Hxfv) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open : forall (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  Grade Q psi s ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b s).
Proof.
  intros Q psi psi0 b L s Hs Hfam.
  exact (@Grade_open_rec 0 Q psi psi0 b L s Hs Hfam).
Qed.
EOF

(* ---------------- uniqueness of grades for a bound name ---------------- *)

Lemma In_dom_mem : forall (E:econtext) x g, In (x,g) E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|[y h] E IH]; intros x g H; simpl in *.
  - destruct H.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply (IH x g Hin).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_binds_det : forall (E:econtext) x g1 g2,
  uniq E -> In (x,g1) E -> In (x,g2) E -> g1 = g2.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|[y h] E IH]; intros x g1 g2 Hu H1 H2.
  - destruct H1.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? HE Hnot]; subst.
    destruct H1 as [Heq1|Hin1]; destruct H2 as [Heq2|Hin2].
    + inversion Heq1. inversion Heq2. reflexivity.
    + inversion Heq1. subst. exfalso. apply Hnot. apply (In_dom_mem E x g2 Hin2).
    + inversion Heq2. subst. exfalso. apply Hnot. apply (In_dom_mem E x g1 Hin1).
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
Qed.
EOF

      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),

(* ---------------- helper facts for Par-reduct regularity ---------------- *)

Lemma CGrade_lc : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. destruct H.
  - apply Grade_lc; assumption.
  - assumption. Qed.

Lemma CGrade_grade_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros P psi phi0 a H Hle. destruct H as [i Hg|lc n u].
  - exact Hg.
  - exfalso. apply n. exact Hle. Qed.

Lemma le_bot : forall psi:grade, q_Bot <= psi.
Proof.
  intro psi. apply leq_meet. rewrite meet_comm. apply meet_Bot_r.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open_cgrade : forall (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  lc_tm s -> CGrade Q psi psi0 s ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b s).
Proof.
  intros Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc Hc Hfam.
  destruct Hc as [i Hg|lc n u].
  - apply (@Grade_open Q psi psi0 b L s Hg Hfam).
  - apply (@Grade_open_lc Q psi psi0 b L s lc n Hfam).
Qed.

Lemma Grade_abs_fam : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (A b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) ->
  exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof. intros. inversion H. eauto. Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_cgrade : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_snd : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_spair_cgrade : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_spair_snd : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_inj1_fst : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_inj2_fst : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.

  1: { (* Par_Pi *) intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd d0 IHfam.
       eapply G_Pi. exact IHd.

       eapply G_Abs.
       - intros x n. apply (IHfam x n).
       - exact IHc. }
  1: { (* Par_WSigma *) intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd d0 IHfam.
       eapply G_WSigma. exact IHd.
       intros x n. apply (IHfam x n). }
  1: { (* Par_WPair *) intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 c IHc d IHd.

       eapply G_Sum; [ exact IHd | exact IHd0 ]. }
  1: { (* Par_Inj1 *) intros P psi a1 a1' d IHd.
       apply G_Inj1. exact IHd. }
  1: { (* Par_Inj2 *) intros P psi a2 a2' d IHd.
       apply G_Inj2. exact IHd. }
  1: { (* Par_CaseBeta1 *) intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 b1' a' b2' d IHd d0 IHd0 d1 IHd1 i.

       eapply CG_Leq; [ exact i | exact IHd ]. }
  1: { (* CPar_Nleq *) intros P psi psi0 a1 a2 l1 l2 n u.
       eapply CG_Nleq; [ exact l2 | exact n | exact u ]. }
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma CPar_cgrade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  CPar P psi phi0 a b -> CGrade P psi phi0 b.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H. induction H as [P psi psi0 a1 a2 i d | P psi psi0 a1 a2 l1 l2 n u].
  - eapply CG_Leq; [ exact i | apply Par_grade_r; exact d ].
  - eapply CG_Nleq; [ exact l2 | exact n | exact u ].
Qed.

Lemma Par_abs_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A a b,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) b ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' a', b = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\
    ((A' = A /\ a' = a) \/
     (CPar P psi q_Top A A' /\
      forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi0) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a b Hpar.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as t eqn:E.
  revert A a E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, a0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_pi_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A B c,
  Par P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) c ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' B', c = a_Pi psi0 A' B' /\
    ((A' = A /\ B' = B) \/ (Par P psi A A' /\ forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B c Hpar.
  remember (a_Pi psi0 A B) as t eqn:E.
  revert A B E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 B0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, B0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

content.text: Now the key parallel-substitution lemma: substituting a `CPar`-related pair into a `Grade`/`CGrade` derivation preserves `Par`/`CPar`.

cat >> /workspace/Dev.v <<'EOF'

(* ---------------- substituting a CPar-related pair preserves Par/CPar ---------------- *)

Lemma Grade_subst_par : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) x gx (u v:tm),
    P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q ->
    CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->
    Par (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm u x a) (subst_tm_tm v x a).
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi a (_:Grade P psi a) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (x:atom) gx (u v:tm),
         P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q -> CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->
         Par (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm u x a) (subst_tm_tm v x a))
    (fun P psi phi0 a (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (x:atom) gx (u v:tm),
         P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q -> CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->
         CPar (C ++ Q) psi phi0 (subst_tm_tm u x a) (subst_tm_tm v x a))).
  1: { (* G_Type *) intros P psi so u0 C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Refl. apply G_Type. apply (@uniq_remove_mid C x gx Q u0). }
  1: { (* G_Var *) intros P psi x0 psi0 u0 i b C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       destruct (eq_var x0 x) as [Heq'|Hne'].
       - rewrite Heq'. rewrite subst_var_same. rewrite subst_var_same.
         assert (b2 : In (x,gx) (C ++ (x,gx)::Q)).
         { apply in_or_app. right. left. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hg : psi0 = gx).
         { eapply (@uniq_binds_det (C ++ (x,gx)::Q) x psi0 gx u0).
           - rewrite Heq' in b. exact b.
           - exact b2. }
         destruct (CPar_cases Hcp) as [[ile Hpar]|[nle _]].
         + exact Hpar.
         + exfalso. apply nle. rewrite <- Hg. exact i.
       - rewrite (@subst_var_neq u x x0 (fun H => Hne' (Logic.eq_sym H))).
         rewrite (@subst_var_neq v x x0 (fun H => Hne' (Logic.eq_sym H))).
         apply Par_Refl. eapply G_Var.
         + apply (@uniq_remove_mid C x gx Q u0).
         + exact i.
         + eapply binds_remove_mid; [ exact b | exact Hne' ]. }
  1: { (* G_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply Par_Pi with (L := L \u {{x}} \u dom (C ++ Q)).
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - intros z nz.
         apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzx nzdom].
         assert (Hzx : z <> x).
         { intro Heq2. apply nzx. subst z. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hcpz : CPar ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi gx u v).
         { apply (@CPar_ins_front (C++Q) psi gx u v Hcp z psi nzdom). }
         assert (GBz : Par (((z,psi)::C) ++ Q) psi
                   (subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))
                   (subst_tm_tm v x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))).
         { apply (IHfam z nzL ((z,psi)::C) Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcpz ]. }
         change (Par ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm u x B) (a_Var_f z))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm v x B) (a_Var_f z))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x u lcu Hzx).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x v lcv Hzx).
         exact GBz. }
  1: { (* G_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A b g0 IHfam c IHc C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply Par_Abs with (L := L \u {{x}} \u dom (C ++ Q)).
       - intros z nz.
         apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzx nzdom].
         assert (Hzx : z <> x).
         { intro Heq2. apply nzx. subst z. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hcpz : CPar ((z,psi0)::(C++Q)) psi gx u v).
         { apply (@CPar_ins_front (C++Q) psi gx u v Hcp z psi0 nzdom). }
         assert (GBz : Par (((z,psi0)::C) ++ Q) psi
                   (subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z)))
                   (subst_tm_tm v x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z)))).
         { apply (IHfam z nzL ((z,psi0)::C) Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcpz ]. }
         change (Par ((z,psi0)::(C++Q)) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm u x b) (a_Var_f z))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm v x b) (a_Var_f z))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b z x u lcu Hzx).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b z x v lcv Hzx).
         exact GBz.
       - apply (IHc C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_App *) intros P psi b psi0 a g IHg c IHc C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_App.
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHc C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_WSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply Par_WSigma with (L := L \u {{x}} \u dom (C ++ Q)).
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - intros z nz.
         apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzx nzdom].
         assert (Hzx : z <> x).
         { intro Heq2. apply nzx. subst z. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hcpz : CPar ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi gx u v).
         { apply (@CPar_ins_front (C++Q) psi gx u v Hcp z psi nzdom). }
         assert (GBz : Par (((z,psi)::C) ++ Q) psi
                   (subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))
                   (subst_tm_tm v x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))).
         { apply (IHfam z nzL ((z,psi)::C) Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcpz ]. }
         change (Par ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm u x B) (a_Var_f z))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm v x B) (a_Var_f z))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x u lcu Hzx).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x v lcv Hzx).
         exact GBz. }
  1: { (* G_WPair *) intros P psi a psi0 b c IHc g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_WPair.
       - apply (IHc C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_LetPair *) intros L P psi psi0 a b g IHg g0 IHfam C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply Par_LetPair with (L := L \u {{x}} \u dom (C ++ Q)).
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - intros z nz.
         apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzx nzdom].
         assert (Hzx : z <> x).
         { intro Heq2. apply nzx. subst z. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hcpz : CPar ((z,psi0)::(C++Q)) psi gx u v).
         { apply (@CPar_ins_front (C++Q) psi gx u v Hcp z psi0 nzdom). }
         assert (GBz : Par (((z,psi0)::C) ++ Q) psi
                   (subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z)))
                   (subst_tm_tm v x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z)))).
         { apply (IHfam z nzL ((z,psi0)::C) Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcpz ]. }
         change (Par ((z,psi0)::(C++Q)) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm u x b) (a_Var_f z))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm v x b) (a_Var_f z))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b z x u lcu Hzx).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b z x v lcv Hzx).
         exact GBz. }
  1: { (* G_SSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply Par_SSigma with (L := L \u {{x}} \u dom (C ++ Q)).
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - intros z nz.
         apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzx nzdom].
         assert (Hzx : z <> x).
         { intro Heq2. apply nzx. subst z. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
         assert (Hcpz : CPar ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi gx u v).
         { apply (@CPar_ins_front (C++Q) psi gx u v Hcp z psi nzdom). }
         assert (GBz : Par (((z,psi)::C) ++ Q) psi
                   (subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))
                   (subst_tm_tm v x (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)))).
         { apply (IHfam z nzL ((z,psi)::C) Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcpz ]. }
         change (Par ((z,psi)::(C++Q)) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm u x B) (a_Var_f z))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm v x B) (a_Var_f z))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x u lcu Hzx).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B z x v lcv Hzx).
         exact GBz. }
  1: { (* G_SPair *) intros P psi a psi0 b c IHc g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_SPair.
       - apply (IHc C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_Proj1 *) intros P psi psi0 a g IHg i C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_Proj1.
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - exact i. }
  1: { (* G_Proj2 *) intros P psi psi0 a g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Proj2. apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_Sum *) intros P psi A B g IHg g0 IHg0 C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_Sum.
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHg0 C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_Inj1 *) intros P psi a g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Inj1. apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_Inj2 *) intros P psi a g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Inj2. apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* G_Case *) intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 g IHg g0 IHg0 g1 IHg1 i C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply Par_Case.
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHg0 C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - apply (IHg1 C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ].
       - exact i. }
  1: { (* G_TyUnit *) intros P psi u0 C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Refl. apply G_TyUnit. apply (@uniq_remove_mid C x gx Q u0). }
  1: { (* G_TmUnit *) intros P psi u0 C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       apply Par_Refl. apply G_TmUnit. apply (@uniq_remove_mid C x gx Q u0). }
  1: { (* CG_Leq *) intros P psi phi0 a i g IHg C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       eapply CPar_Leq.
       - exact i.
       - apply (IHg C Q x gx u v); [ reflexivity | exact Hcp ]. }
  1: { (* CG_Nleq *) intros P psi phi0 a l n u0 C Q x gx u v Heq Hcp. subst P.
       assert (lcu : lc_tm u) by (apply (proj1 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       assert (lcv : lc_tm v) by (apply (proj2 (CPar_lc Hcp))).
       eapply CPar_Nleq.
       - exact lcu.
       - exact lcv.
       - exact n.
       - apply (@uniq_remove_mid C x gx Q u0). }
  exact H.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Par_subst_var : forall (C Q:econtext) x gx psi (s t:tm),
  Par (C ++ (x,gx)::Q) psi s t ->
  forall u v, CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->
    Par (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm u x s) (subst_tm_tm v x t).
Proof.
  intros C Q x gx psi s t H.
  refine (@Par_mut
    (fun P psi s t (_:Par P psi s t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (x:atom) gx (u v:tm),
         P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q -> CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->
         Par (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm u x s) (subst_tm_tm v x t))
    (fun P psi phi0 s t (_:CPar P psi phi0 s t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (x:atom) gx (u v:tm),
         P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q -> CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->

    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (C ++ (x,gx)::Q) psi s t H).

Lemma open_close_subst_gen : forall (E:tm) n z x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n z E)
  = subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as

(* ---------------- inversion of Par by head constructor ---------------- *)

Lemma Par_wpair_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b c,
  Par P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) c ->
  exists a' b', c = a_WPair a' psi0 b' /\
    ((a' = a /\ b' = b) \/ (CPar P psi psi0 a a' /\ Par P psi b b')).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b c H.
  remember (a_WPair a psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert a b E.
  induction H; intros a0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0, b0. split; [reflexivity | left; auto].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity | right; split]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_spair_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b c,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) c ->
  exists a' b', c = a_SPair a' psi0 b' /\
    ((a' = a /\ b' = b) \/ (CPar P psi psi0 a a' /\ Par P psi b b')).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b c H.
  remember (a_SPair a psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert a b E.
  induction H; intros a0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0, b0. split; [reflexivity | left; auto].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity | right; split]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_inj1_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi a c,
  Par P psi (a_Inj1 a) c ->
  exists a', c = a_Inj1 a' /\ (a' = a \/ Par P psi a a').
Proof.
  intros P psi a c H.
  remember (a_Inj1 a) as t eqn:E. revert a E.
  induction H; intros a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0. split; [reflexivity | left; auto].
  - eexists. split; [reflexivity | right; eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma Par_inj2_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi a c,
  Par P psi (a_Inj2 a) c ->
  exists a', c = a_Inj2 a' /\ (a' = a \/ Par P psi a a').
Proof.
  intros P psi a c H.
  remember (a_Inj2 a) as t eqn:E. revert a E.
  induction H; intros a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0. split; [reflexivity | left; auto].

Lemma Par_proj1_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) c ->
  (c = a_Proj1 psi0 a) \/

  (exists a1' a2, c = a1' /\ Par P psi a (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) /\ psi0 <= psi).

  - right. right. exists a1', a2. split; [reflexivity | split]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_proj2_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a c,

  - right. right. exists L0, a1', a2', b2. split; [reflexivity | split]; eassumption.

  - right. right. right. exists a', b1', b2'. split; [reflexivity | split; [ | split; [ | split]]]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_app_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 f b c,

  - right. right. exists a', b'. split; [reflexivity | split]; eassumption.

(* ---------------- body families of parallel reduction at binders ---------------- *)

Lemma Par_abs_body_family : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A a d,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d ->
  exists (L:vars) A' B, d = a_Abs psi0 A' B /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
       Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a d H.
  destruct (Par_abs_inv H) as [L2 A' a' [Heq [[HA Ha]| [Hcp Hfam]]]].
  - subst A'. subst a'.
    destruct (Grade_abs_fam (Par_grade_r H)) as [Lg Hfg].
    exists (L2 \u Lg), A, a. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx2 Hxg].
      apply Par_Refl. apply Hfg. exact Hxg.
  - exists L2, A', a'. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + exact Hfam.
Qed.

Lemma Par_pi_body_family : forall (P:econtext) psi psi1 A B d,
  Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A B) d ->
  exists (L:vars) A' B', d = a_Pi psi1 A' B' /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
       Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi1 A B d H.
  destruct (Par_pi_inv H) as [L2 A' B' [Heq [[HA HB]| [HparA Hfam]]]].

      apply Par_Refl. apply Hfg. exact Hxg.
  - exists L2, A', B'. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + exact Hfam.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Par_dia_cpar_leq : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a1 a2,
  phi0 <= psi ->
  Par P psi a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a1 c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a1 c ->
    exists d, CPar P psi phi0 a2 d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a1 a2 Hle d IHd c H2.
  destruct (CPar_cases H2) as [[Hle2 Hpar]|[Hnle _]].
  - destruct (IHd c Hpar) as [d0 [Ha2 Hc0]].
    exists d0. split; eapply CPar_Leq; eassumption.
  - exfalso. apply Hnle. exact Hle.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_cpar_nleq : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a1 a2,
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 -> ~ (phi0 <= psi) -> uniq P ->
  forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a1 c ->
    exists d, CPar P psi phi0 a2 d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a1 a2 l1 l2 Hnle Hu c H2.
  destruct (CPar_cases H2) as [[Hle2 _]|[Hnle2 [lc1 [[lc2 Hu2]]]]].
  - exfalso. apply Hnle. exact Hle2.
  - exists c. split.
    + eapply CPar_Nleq; [ exact l2 | exact lc2 | exact Hnle | exact Hu ].
    + eapply CPar_Nleq; [ exact lc2 | exact lc2 | exact Hnle | exact Hu ].
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_appbeta : forall (P:econtext) psi a psi0 b a' b' A,
  Par P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a') ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a') d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
  (forall c, CPar P psi psi0 b c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b' d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a psi0 b a' b' A d IHd c0 IHc c H2.
  destruct (Par_app_cases H2) as [Heq|Hbeta|Hcong].
  - rewrite Heq.
    exists (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b'). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_AppBeta; eassumption.
    + eapply Par_AppBeta; eassumption.
  - destruct Hbeta as [A2 [a2' [b2' HD]]].
    destruct HD as [Heq HD2]. destruct HD2 as [Hpar Hcpar].
    destruct (IHd (a_Abs psi0 A2 a2') Hpar) as [dad [Hdad1 Hdad2]].
    destruct (IHc b2' Hcpar) as [db [Hdb1 Hdb2]].
    destruct (Par_abs_body_family Hdad1) as [L1 [Ad [Bd1 [Heq1 Hfam1]]]].
    destruct (Par_abs_body_family Hdad2) as [L2 [Ad2 [Bd2 [Heq2 Hfam2]]]].
    rewrite Heq1 in Heq2. inversion Heq2. subst.
    exists (open_tm_wrt_tm Bd1 db). split.
    + exact (@Par_open P psi psi0 a' Bd1 L1 b' db Hfam1 Hdb1).
    + rewrite Heq.
      exact (@Par_open P psi psi0 a2' Bd1 L2 b2' db Hfam2 Hdb2).
  - destruct Hcong as [f2 [b2' HD]].
    destruct HD as [Heq HD2]. destruct HD2 as [Hpar Hcpar].
    destruct (IHd f2 Hpar) as [daf [Hdaf1 Hdaf2]].
    destruct (IHc b2' Hcpar) as [db [Hdb1 Hdb2]].
    destruct (Par_abs_body_family Hdaf1) as [L1 [Ad [Bd [Heq1 Hfam1]]]].
    exists (open_tm_wrt_tm Bd db). split.
    + exact (@Par_open P psi psi0 a' Bd L1 b' db Hfam1 Hdb1).
    + rewrite Heq.
      eapply Par_AppBeta.
      * rewrite <- Heq1. exact Hdaf2.
      * exact Hdb2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_app : forall (P:econtext) psi a psi0 b a2 b2,
  Par P psi a a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 b b2 ->
  (forall c, CPar P psi psi0 b c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b2 d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_App a2 psi0 b2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a psi0 b a2 b2 d IHd c0 IHc c H2.
  destruct (Par_app_cases H2) as [Heq|Hbeta|Hcong].
  - rewrite Heq.
    exists (a_App a2 psi0 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_App; eassumption.
    + eapply Par_App; eassumption.
  - destruct Hbeta as [A [a' [b' HD]]].
    destruct HD as [Heq HD2]. destruct HD2 as [Hpar Hcpar].
    destruct (IHd (a_Abs psi0 A a') Hpar) as [daf [Hdaf1 Hdaf2]].
    destruct (IHc b' Hcpar) as [db [Hdb1 Hdb2]].
    destruct (Par_abs_body_family Hdaf1) as [L1 [Ad [Bd [Heq1 Hfam1]]]].
    exists (open_tm_wrt_tm Bd db). split.
    + eapply Par_AppBeta.
      * exact Hdaf2.
      * exact Hdb2.
    + rewrite Heq.
      exact (@Par_open P psi psi0 a' Bd L1 b' db Hfam1 Hdb1).
  - destruct Hcong as [f' [b' HD]].
    destruct HD as [Heq HD2]. destruct HD2 as [Hpar Hcpar].
    destruct (IHd f' Hpar) as [daf [Hdaf1 Hdaf2]].
    destruct (IHc b' Hcpar) as [db [Hdb1 Hdb2]].
    exists (a_App daf psi0 db). split.
    + eapply Par_App; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_App; eassumption.
Qed.

input.command:
cat >> /workspace/Dev.v <<'EOF'

Lemma CPar_par_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a b,
  CPar P psi phi0 a b -> phi0 <= psi -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H Hle.
  destruct (CPar_cases H) as [Hl|Hr].
  - destruct Hl as [Hle2 Hpar]. exact Hpar.
  - destruct Hr as [Hnle _]. exfalso. apply Hnle. exact Hle.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_spair_fst_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b,
  Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> psi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@CGrade_grade_of_le P psi psi0 a).
  - apply Grade_spair_cgrade. exact H.
  - exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_fst_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b,
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> psi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@CGrade_grade_of_le P psi psi0 a).
  - apply Grade_wpair_cgrade. exact H.
  - exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_abs_body_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A b,
  Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) -> psi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A b Hg Hle.
  destruct (Grade_abs_fam Hg) as [L Hfam].
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
  exact (Hfam x Hx).
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Par_dia_proj1 : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a a2,
  psi0 <= psi ->
  Par P psi a a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a a2 Hle d IHd c H2.
  destruct (Par_proj1_cases H2) as [Heq|[Hcong|Hbeta]].
  - rewrite Heq. exists (a_Proj1 psi0 a2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Proj1; eassumption.
    + eapply Par_Proj1; eassumption.
  - destruct Hcong as [a'' [Heq [Hpar Hle2]]].
    destruct (IHd a'' Hpar) as [dA [Ha2 Ha'']].
    exists (a_Proj1 psi0 dA). split.
    + eapply Par_Proj1; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Proj1; eassumption.
  - destruct Hbeta as [a1'' [a2'' [Heq [Hpar Hle2]]]].
    destruct (IHd (a_SPair a1'' psi0 a2'') Hpar) as [dSP [H1 H2p]].
    destruct (Par_spair_inv H2p) as [c1 [c2 [Heq1 HD1]]].
    assert (HP1 : Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a2) c1).
    { eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
      - exact H1.
      - exact Hle. }
    assert (HP2 : Par P psi a1'' c1).
    { destruct HD1 as [Hrefl|Hcp].
      - destruct Hrefl as [E1 E2]. rewrite E1.
        apply Par_Refl. apply (@Grade_spair_fst_of_le P psi psi0 a1'' a2'').
        + exact (Par_grade_r Hpar).
        + exact Hle2.
      - destruct Hcp as [Hcpar Hpar2].
        exact (@CPar_par_of_le P psi psi0 a1'' c1 Hcpar Hle2). }
    exists c1. split.
    + exact HP1.
    + rewrite Heq. exact HP2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_proj2beta : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a a1' a2,
  Par P psi a (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a a1' a2 d IHd c H2.
  destruct (Par_proj2_cases H2) as [Heq|[Hcong|Hbeta]].
  - rewrite Heq.
    assert (Hfirst : Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) a2).
    { eapply Par_Proj2Beta; eassumption. }
    exists a2. split.
    + apply Par_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hfirst).
    + exact Hfirst.
  - destruct Hcong as [a'' [Heq Hpar]].
    destruct (IHd a'' Hpar) as [dSP [H1 H2p]].
    destruct (Par_spair_inv H1) as [c1 [c2 [Heq1 HD1]]].
    assert (HP1 : Par P psi a2 c2).
    { destruct HD1 as [Hrefl|Hcp].
      - destruct Hrefl as [E1 E2]. rewrite E2.
        apply Par_Refl. apply (@Grade_spair_snd P psi psi0 a1' a2). exact (Par_grade_r d).
      - destruct Hcp as [Hcpar Hpar2]. exact Hpar2. }
    exists c2. split.
    + exact HP1.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
      rewrite <- Heq1. exact H2p.
  - destruct Hbeta as [a1'' [a2'' [Heq Hpar]]].
    destruct (IHd (a_SPair a1'' psi0 a2'') Hpar) as [dSP [H1 H2p]].
    destruct (Par_spair_inv H1) as [c1 [c2 [Heq1 HD1]]].
    destruct (Par_spair_inv H2p) as [e1 [e2 [Heq2 HD2]]].
    rewrite Heq1 in Heq2. injection Heq2 as Hc Hd.
    rewrite <- Hd in HD2.
    assert (HP1 : Par P psi a2 c2).
    { destruct HD1 as [Hrefl|Hcp].
      - destruct Hrefl as [E1 E2]. rewrite E2.
        apply Par_Refl. apply (@Grade_spair_snd P psi psi0 a1' a2). exact (Par_grade_r d).
      - destruct Hcp as [Hcpar Hpar2]. exact Hpar2. }
    assert (HP2 : Par P psi a2'' c2).
    { destruct HD2 as [Hrefl|Hcp].
      - destruct Hrefl as [E1 E2]. rewrite E2.
        apply Par_Refl. apply (@Grade_spair_snd P psi psi0 a1'' a2''). exact (Par_grade_r Hpar).
      - destruct Hcp as [Hcpar Hpar2]. exact Hpar2. }
    exists c2. split.
    + exact HP1.
    + rewrite Heq. exact HP2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_proj2 : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a a2,

      - destruct Hcp as [Hcpar Hpar2]. exact Hpar2. }
    exists c2. split.
    + exact HP1.
    + rewrite Heq. exact HP2.

  Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi (a_Inj2 a') d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  Par P psi b1 b1' ->
  (forall c, Par P psi b1 c -> exists d, Par P psi b1' d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  Par P psi b2 b2' ->
  (forall c, Par P psi b2 c -> exists d, Par P psi b2' d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_App b2' psi0 a') d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 b1' a' b2' Hle d IHd d1 IHd1 d2 IHd2 c H2.
  destruct (Par_case_cases H2) as
    [Heq | aI bI1 bI2 HeqB Hpar Hpar1 Hpar2 Hle2

(* ---------------- multi-step parallel reduction: composition and confluence ---------------- *)

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
  - apply GEq_sym. exact geq.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.

| GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)

     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->

    | psi A B HlA IHA HlB IHB | a0 psi b Hla IHa Hlb IHb
    | psi a0 b Hla IHa Hlb IHb
    | psi A B HlA IHA HlB IHB | a0 psi b Hla IHa Hlb IHb

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm B' ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Sum A B) )   ( (a_Sum A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_Step_R : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( ValueType a )  ->
     Consistent a b
 | Consistent_a_Step_L : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not ( ValueType b )  ->
     Consistent a b.

Lemma Grade_subst_mid : forall (P:econtext) psi (t:tm), Grade P psi t ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) dx dgx (s:tm),
    P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi s ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx t).
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 t0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi t (_:Grade P psi t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (dx:atom) (dgx:grade) (s:tm),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q -> Grade (C ++ Q) psi s ->
         Grade (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx t))
    (fun P psi phi0 t (_:CGrade P psi phi0 t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (dx:atom) (dgx:grade) (s:tm),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q -> Grade (C ++ Q) psi s ->
         CGrade (C ++ Q) psi phi0 (subst_tm_tm s dx t))).
  1: { (* G_Type *) intros P psi so u C Q dx dgx s Heq Hs. subst P.
       apply G_Type. apply (@uniq_remove_mid C dx dgx Q u). }
  1: { (* G_Var *) intros P psi x psi0 u i b C Q dx dgx s Heq Hs. subst P.
       destruct (eq_var x dx) as [Heq'|Hne'].
       - rewrite Heq'. rewrite subst_var_same. exact Hs.
       - rewrite (@subst_var_neq s dx x (fun H => Hne' (Logic.eq_sym H))).
         eapply G_Var.
         + apply (@uniq_remove_mid C dx dgx Q u).
         + exact i.
         + eapply binds_remove_mid; [ exact b | exact Hne' ]. }
  1: { (* G_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg g0 IHfam C Q dx dgx s Heq Hs. subst P.
       eapply G_Pi with (L := L \u {{dx}} \u dom (C ++ Q) \u fv_tm_tm s).

    ~ (dgx <= psi) ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm s dx t).
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 t0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi t (_:Grade P psi t) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (dx:atom) (dgx:grade) (s:tm),
         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q -> lc_tm s -> ~ (dgx <= psi) ->

    (fun P psi phi0 t (_:CGrade P psi phi0 t) =>

         P = C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q -> lc_tm s -> ~ (dgx <= psi) ->

  1: { (* G_Type *) intros P psi so u C Q dx dgx s Heq Hlc Hnle. subst P.

  1: { (* G_Var *) intros P psi x psi0 u i b C Q dx dgx s Heq Hlc Hnle. subst P.
       destruct (eq_var x dx) as [Heq'|Hne'].
       - assert (b2 : In (dx,dgx) (C ++ (dx,dgx)::Q)).

Lemma Grade_subst_par : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->

Proof.

    (fun P psi a (_:Grade P psi a) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (x:atom) gx (u v:tm),
         P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q -> CPar (C ++ Q) psi gx u v ->

Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[z gz] C IH]; intros x g Q H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. assumption.

  x `notin` fv_tm_tm b ->
  subst_tm_tm a x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a b.
Proof.
  intros b. induction b as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | n | x0
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros x a k Hfv; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HfvA HfvB].
    rewrite (IHA x a k HfvA). rewrite (IHB x a (S k) HfvB). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HfvA Hfvb].
    rewrite (IHA x a k HfvA). rewrite (IHb x a (S k) Hfvb). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hfva Hfvb].
    rewrite (IHa x a k Hfva). rewrite (IHb x a k Hfvb). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + subst n. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity.
Lemma subst_open_comm : forall (B:tm) z dx (a:tm) k,
  lc_tm a -> z <> dx ->
  subst_tm_tm a dx (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) B)
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) (subst_tm_tm a dx B).
Proof.
  intros B. induction B as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | n | x0
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros z dx a k Hlc Hne; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA z dx a k Hlc Hne). rewrite (IHB z dx a (S k) Hlc Hne). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA z dx a k Hlc Hne). rewrite (IHb z dx a (S k) Hlc Hne). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa z dx a k Hlc Hne). rewrite (IHb z dx a k Hlc Hne). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
Lemma subst_open_open : forall (b:tm) x (s a:tm) k,
  lc_tm s ->
  subst_tm_tm s x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a b)
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (subst_tm_tm s x a) (subst_tm_tm s x b).
Proof.
  intros b. induction b as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | so | n | x0
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros x s a k Hlc; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHB x s a (S k) Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb x s a (S k) Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + subst n. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var x0 x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      rewrite (@open_rec_lc s k (subst_tm_tm s x a) Hlc). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA1 x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHA2 x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb1 x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb2 x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHB x s a (S k) Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb x s a (S k) Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHA x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHB x s a (S k) Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). rewrite (IHb x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa x s a k Hlc). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_term : forall (b:tm) x (s a:tm),
  lc_tm s ->
  subst_tm_tm s x (open_tm_wrt_tm b a)

Proof.
  intros b x s a Hlc. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm.
  apply (@subst_open_open b x s a 0 Hlc).

(* ---------------- basic facts about meet_ctx_l and Typing grades ---------------- *)

Lemma meet_ctx_l_app : forall (psi:grade) (W1 W2:context),
  meet_ctx_l psi (W1 ++ W2) = meet_ctx_l psi W1 ++ meet_ctx_l psi W2.
Proof. intros psi W1. induction W1 as [|[x [g A]] W1 IH]; intros W2; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite IH; reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma meet_ctx_l_cons : forall (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) g (A:tm) (W:context),
  meet_ctx_l psi ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) = (x ~ (psi + g, A)) ++ meet_ctx_l psi W.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma uniq_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context),
  uniq W -> uniq (meet_ctx_l psi W).
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; intros H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - inversion H as [|? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. apply (proj1 (@dom_app _ (meet_ctx_l psi W) (x ~ (psi + g, A)))).
      simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma dom_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context), dom (meet_ctx_l psi W) [=] dom W.
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context) (x:tmvar) g (A:tm),
  binds x (g,A) W -> binds x (psi + g, A) (meet_ctx_l psi W).
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[y [gy Ay]] W IH]; intros x g A H; simpl in *.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin]; [inversion Heq; subst; left; reflexivity | exact Hin].
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. left. reflexivity.
    + right. eapply IH; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma meet_ctx_l_idem : forall (psi:grade) (W:context),
  meet_ctx_l psi (meet_ctx_l psi W) = meet_ctx_l psi W.
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite <- meet_assoc. rewrite meet_idem. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma meet_lower_r : forall (a b:grade), (a + b) <= b.
Proof. intros. rewrite <- (meet_idem b). apply leq_meet. rewrite meet_assoc. rewrite meet_idem. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma join_bot_l : forall a:grade, q_Bot * a = a.
Proof. intros a. apply join_leq. apply le_bot. Qed.

Lemma join_bot_r : forall a:grade, a * q_Bot = a.

Lemma join_ub_l : forall a b:grade, a <= a * b.
Proof. intros a b. apply leq_join. rewrite <- join_assoc. rewrite join_idem. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma join_ub_r : forall a b:grade, b <= a * b.
Proof. intros a b. rewrite join_comm. apply join_ub_l. Qed.

Lemma join_mono_l : forall a b c:grade, a <= b -> c * a <= c * b.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hle. apply leq_join. rewrite <- join_assoc. rewrite <- join_assoc.
  rewrite (join_leq a b Hle). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma join_mono_r : forall a b c:grade, a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hle. rewrite (join_comm a c). rewrite (join_comm b c).
  apply join_mono_l. exact Hle.
Qed.

    apply join_ub_l.
Qed.

(* ---------------- a context relation witnessing an ambient-grade raise ----------------

   Rctx p p' W W' relates two contexts where every binding is either
   unchanged, obtained by joining a common annotation B with p / p', or
   a "meet" binding with only the bounds grades <= q_C.  This is exactly
   stable under the context manipulations performed by the Typing rules. *)

Inductive Rctx (p p':grade) : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | RC_nil : Rctx p p' nil nil
 | RC_fixed : forall x g (A:tm) (W W':context),
     Rctx p p' W W' ->
     Rctx p p' ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W')
 | RC_join : forall x b p0 p0' B (A:tm) (W W':context),
     p0 <= p0' ->
     p = q_join B p0 ->
     p' = q_join B p0' ->
     Rctx p p' W W' ->
     Rctx p p' ((x ~ (q_join b p0, A)) ++ W) ((x ~ (q_join b p0', A)) ++ W')
 | RC_meet : forall x m1 m2 (A:tm) (W W':context),
     m1 <= q_C -> m2 <= q_C -> q_C <= p -> q_C <= p' ->
     Rctx p p' W W' ->
     Rctx p p' ((x ~ (m1,A)) ++ W) ((x ~ (m2,A)) ++ W').

Lemma Rctx_dom : forall p p' (W W':context), Rctx p p' W W' -> dom W [=] dom W'.
Proof.
  intros p p' W W' H. induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Rctx_uniq : forall p p' (W W':context), Rctx p p' W W' -> uniq W -> uniq W'.
Proof.
  intros p p' W W' H. induction H; intros Hu; simpl in *.
  - exact Hu.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- H. exact Hin.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- H. exact Hin.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- H. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma Rctx_binds : forall p p' (W W':context) x g (A:tm),
  Rctx p p' W W' -> binds x (g,A) W ->
  exists g', binds x (g',A) W' /\
    (g' = g \/
     (exists b p0 p0' B, g = q_join b p0 /\ g' = q_join b p0' /\
        p0 <= p0' /\ p = q_join B p0 /\ p' = q_join B p0') \/
     (g <= q_C /\ g' <= q_C)).
Proof.
  intros p p' W W' x g A H. induction H; intros Hb; simpl in Hb.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists g. split; [left; reflexivity|left; reflexivity].
    + destruct (IHH Hin) as [g' [Hb' Hrel]]. exists g'; split; [right; exact Hb'|exact Hrel].
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists (q_join b p0').
      split; [left; reflexivity|right; left].
      exists b, p0, p0', B. repeat split; assumption.
    + destruct (IHH Hin) as [g' [Hb' Hrel]]. exists g'; split; [right; exact Hb'|exact Hrel].
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists m2.
      split; [left; reflexivity|right; right]. split; assumption.
    + destruct (IHH Hin) as [g' [Hb' Hrel]]. exists g'; split; [right; exact Hb'|exact Hrel].
Qed.

Lemma Rctx_join_ambient : forall a p p' (W W':context),
  Rctx p p' W W' -> Rctx (q_join a p) (q_join a p') W W'.
Proof.
  intros a p p' W W' H. induction H.
  - apply RC_nil.
  - apply RC_fixed. exact IH.
  - eapply RC_join with (b:=b) (p0:=p0) (p0':=p0') (B:=q_join a B).
    + exact H.
    + rewrite H0. rewrite join_assoc. reflexivity.
    + rewrite H1. rewrite join_assoc. reflexivity.
    + exact IH.
  - apply RC_meet with (m1:=m1) (m2:=m2).
    + exact H.
    + exact H0.
    + eapply le_trans_g; [ exact H1 | apply join_ub_r ].
    + eapply le_trans_g; [ exact H2 | apply join_ub_r ].
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma Rctx_meet : forall p p' (W W':context),
  Rctx p p' W W' ->
  Rctx q_C q_C (meet_ctx_l q_C W) (meet_ctx_l q_C W').
Proof.
  intros p p' W W' H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply RC_nil.
  - apply RC_meet with (m1:=q_C + g) (m2:=q_C + g).
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + exact IH.
  - apply RC_meet with (m1:=q_C + (b * p0)) (m2:=q_C + (b * p0')).
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + exact IH.
  - apply RC_meet with (m1:=q_C + m1) (m2:=q_C + m2).
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply meet_lower_r.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + apply le_refl_g.
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma Rctx_cons_join : forall p p' b (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (W W':context),
  p <= p' -> Rctx p p' W W' ->
  Rctx p p' ((x ~ (q_join b p, A)) ++ W) ((x ~ (q_join b p', A)) ++ W').
Proof.
  intros p p' b x A W W' Hle H.
  eapply RC_join with (b:=b) (p0:=p) (p0':=p') (B:=q_Bot).
  - exact Hle.
  - rewrite join_comm. apply join_bot_l.
  - rewrite join_comm. apply join_bot_l.
  - exact H.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Grade_relabel_mut : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> Grade P' psi a.
Proof.
  intros P0 psi0 a0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi a (_:Grade P psi a) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> Grade P' psi a)
    (fun P psi phi0 a (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> CGrade P' psi phi0 a)).
  1: { (* G_Type *) intros P psi s Hu P' Hr. apply G_Type. exact (grade_rel_uniq' Hr). }
  1: { (* G_Var *) intros P psi x psi0 Hu Hb Hle P' Hr. eapply G_Var.
       - exact (grade_rel_uniq' Hr).
       - assert (Hxin : x `in` dom P) by (eapply In_dom_mem; exact Hb).
         assert (Hxin' : x `in` dom P').
         { rewrite <- (grade_rel_dom Hr). exact Hxin. }
         destruct (@binds_In_inv grade x P' Hxin') as [g' Hb'].
         destruct (grade_rel_binds Hr Hb Hb') as [Heq|[_ Hg']].
         + subst g'. exact Hle.
         + exact Hg'.
       - assert (Hxin : x `in` dom P) by (eapply In_dom_mem; exact Hb).
         assert (Hxin' : x `in` dom P').
         { rewrite <- (grade_rel_dom Hr). exact Hxin. }
         destruct (@binds_In_inv grade x P' Hxin') as [g' Hb'].
         exact Hb'. }
  1: { (* G_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg fam IHfam P' Hr.
       eapply G_Pi with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHg; exact Hr.
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxdom].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxdom. destruct Hxdom as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHfam x HxL ((x,psi)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP']. }
  1: { (* G_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A b fam IHfam c IHc P' Hr.
       eapply G_Abs with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxdom].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxdom. destruct Hxdom as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHfam x HxL ((x,psi0)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP'].
====

Lemma meet_ctx_l_idem : forall (psi:grade) (W:context),
  meet_ctx_l psi (meet_ctx_l psi W) = meet_ctx_l psi W.
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite meet_assoc. rewrite meet_idem. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma meet_lower_r : forall (a b:grade), (a + b) <= b.
Proof. intros a b. apply leq_meet. rewrite <- meet_assoc. rewrite meet_idem. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma meet_C_lower : forall g:grade, q_C + g <= q_C.
Proof. intros g. rewrite meet_comm. apply meet_lower_r. Qed.

Lemma Typing_le_C : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> psi <= q_C.
Proof.
  intros W psi a A H. induction H.
  all: try assumption.
  (* T_Abs: only the universally quantified body premise mentions psi *)
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [z Hz].
  exact (H0 z Hz).
Qed.

Lemma join_bot_l : forall a:grade, q_Bot * a = a.
Proof. intros a. apply join_leq. apply le_bot. Qed.

Lemma join_bot_r : forall a:grade, a * q_Bot = a.
Proof. intros a. rewrite join_comm. apply join_bot_l. Qed.

Lemma CGrade_relabel : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> CGrade P' psi phi0 a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H P' Hr. destruct H.
  - apply CG_Leq; [ exact H | exact (@Grade_relabel_mut P psi a H0 P' Hr) ].
  - apply CG_Nleq; [ exact H | exact H0 | exact H1 | exact (grade_rel_uniq' Hr) ].
Qed.

Scheme DefEq_mut := Induction for DefEq Sort Prop
  with CDefEq_mut := Induction for CDefEq Sort Prop.

Lemma DefEq_relabel_mut : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  DefEq P psi a b -> forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> DefEq P' psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P0 psi0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (DefEq_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:DefEq P psi a b) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> DefEq P' psi a b)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> CDefEq P' psi phi0 a b)).
  1: { (* Eq_Refl *) intros P psi a Hg P' Hr. apply Eq_Refl.
       exact (@Grade_relabel_mut P psi a Hg P' Hr). }
  1: { (* Eq_Trans *) intros P psi a c b H1 IH1 H2 IH2 P' Hr.
       eapply Eq_Trans.
       - apply IH1; exact Hr.
       - apply IH2; exact Hr. }
  1: { (* Eq_Sym *) intros P psi b a H1 IH1 P' Hr.
       apply Eq_Sym. apply IH1; exact Hr. }
  1: { (* Eq_Beta *) intros P psi a b Hg Hstep Hg' P' Hr.
       eapply Eq_Beta.
       - exact (@Grade_relabel_mut P psi a Hg P' Hr).
       - exact Hstep.
       - exact (@Grade_relabel_mut P psi b Hg' P' Hr). }
  1: { (* Eq_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 Hd IHd Hf IHf P' Hr.
       eapply Eq_Pi with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHd; exact Hr.
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxd].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxd. destruct Hxd as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHf x HxL ((x,psi)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP']. }
  1: { (* Eq_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 Hd IHd Hf IHf P' Hr.
       eapply Eq_Abs with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHd; exact Hr.
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxd].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxd. destruct Hxd as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHf x HxL ((x,psi0)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP']. }
  1: { (* Eq_App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 Hf IHf Ha IHa P' Hr.
       eapply Eq_App.
       - apply IHf; exact Hr.
       - apply IHa; exact Hr. }
  1: { (* Eq_PiFst *) intros P psi A1 A2 psi0 B1 B2 Hp IHp P' Hr.

  1: { (* Eq_Sum *) intros P psi A1 A2 A1' A2' H1 IH1 H2 IH2 P' Hr.

  1: { (* Eq_SumFst *) intros P psi A1 A1' A2 A2' Hp IHp P' Hr.
