Lemma subst_open_id : forall (b:tm) x (s:tm),
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm b ->
  subst_tm_tm s x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) = open_tm_wrt_tm b s.
Proof.
  intros b x s Hfv. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm.
  apply (@subst_open_rec b x s 0 Hfv).
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open_lc : forall (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  lc_tm s ->
  ~ (psi0 <= psi) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b s).
Proof.
  intros Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc Hnle Hfam.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm b)) as [x Hx].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxfv].
  assert (Hbody : Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))).
  { apply Hfam; exact HxL. }
  assert (Hres : Grade Q psi (subst_tm_tm s x (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)))).
  { apply (@Grade_subst_mid_lc ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) Hbody
             nil Q x psi0 s).
    - reflexivity.
    - exact Hlc.
    - exact Hnle. }
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b x s Hxfv) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

(* ================= conversion/confluence layer ================= *)

(* ---------------- small context helpers for renaming ---------------- *)

Lemma In_cons_weaken : forall (C Q:econtext) (a:tmvar * grade) x g,
  In a (C ++ Q) -> In a (C ++ (x,g)::Q).
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[w gw] C IH]; intros Q a x g Hin; simpl in *.
  - apply in_or_app in Hin. apply in_or_app. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + left. exact Hin.
    + right. right. exact Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. exact Heq.
    + right. eapply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_cons_cons : forall (C Q:econtext) z g x,
  x `notin` dom (C ++ Q) -> x <> z -> x `notin` dom (((z,g)::C) ++ Q).
Proof.
  intros C Q z g x Hx Hne. simpl.
  intro Hin. apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
  - apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in Hin. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Hin.
  - exact (Hx Hin).
Qed.

(* ================================================================
   Gradeability of typed terms at the meet grade q_C.

   The central ingredient is a relation [meet_target W P] between a
   typing context [W] and an econtext [P] saying that every binding of
   [W] is represented in [P] at the same atom and type, with the
   grade either lowered by q_C (the "meet" grade) or, when the original
   binding has grade above q_C, replaced by an arbitrary grade.

   At ambient grade q_C such a context can still grade the term: bindings
   whose original grade is above q_C could never be used in the typing
   (all ambient grades are <= q_C), so their target grade is irrelevant.
   ================================================================ *)

Inductive meet_target : context -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | mt_nil : meet_target nil nil
 | mt_cons : forall (x:tmvar) (g m:grade) (A:tm) (W:context) (P:econtext),
     meet_target W P ->
     (g <= q_C -> m <= q_C) ->
     meet_target ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) ((x ~ m) ++ P).

Lemma meet_target_dom : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> dom W [=] dom P.
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHmeet_target. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_uniq : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> uniq W -> uniq P.
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H; intros Hu; simpl in *.
  - exact Hu.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst.
    apply uniq_cons.
    + exact (IHmeet_target Htail).
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- meet_target_dom. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_binds : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P ->
  forall (x:tmvar) (g:grade) (A:tm),
    binds x (g,A) W ->
    exists m, binds x (m,A) P /\ (g <= q_C -> m <= q_C).
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H; intros x g A Hb; simpl in Hb.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists m. split; [left; reflexivity|exact H0].
    + destruct (IHmeet_target x g A Hin) as [m' [Hb' Hle]].
      exists m'. split; [right; exact Hb'|exact Hle].
Qed.

(* all original bindings are already <= q_C (this is the degenerate
   situation q_Top <= q_C) *)
Lemma meet_target_meet_ctx_top : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> q_Top <= q_C ->
  meet_target (meet_ctx_l q_C W) P.
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; intros Hmt Htop; simpl in *.
  - inversion Hmt; subst. apply mt_nil.
  - inversion Hmt as [|? ? m ? ? ? Hmt' Hcond]; subst.
    apply mt_cons with (g := q_C + g) (m := m).
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + intro _. eapply le_trans_g; [ apply le_qTop | exact Htop ].
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_self_meet : forall (W:context),
  meet_target W (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)).
Proof.
  intro W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - apply mt_nil.
  - apply mt_cons with (g := g) (m := q_C + g).
    + exact IH.
    + intro _. apply meet_C_lower.
Qed.
EOF

(* ================= Gradeability at q_C of typed terms ================= *)

Inductive meet_target : context -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | mt_nil : meet_target nil nil
 | mt_cons : forall (x:tmvar) (g m:grade) (A:tm) (W:context) (P:econtext),
     meet_target W P ->
     (g <= q_C -> m <= q_C) ->
     meet_target ((x ~ (g,A)) ++ W) ((x ~ m) ++ P).

Lemma meet_target_dom : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> dom W [=] dom P.
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H as [| x g m A W0 P0 Hmt IH Hcond]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_uniq : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> uniq W -> uniq P.
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H as [| x g m A W0 P0 Hmt IH Hcond]; intros Hu; simpl in *.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst.
    apply uniq_cons.
    + exact (IH Htail).
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot.
      exact (proj2 ((@meet_target_dom W0 P0 Hmt) x) Hin).
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_binds : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P ->
  forall (x:tmvar) (g:grade) (A:tm),
    binds x (g,A) W ->
    exists m, binds x m P /\ (g <= q_C -> m <= q_C).
Proof.
  intros W P H. induction H as [| y g0 m0 A0 W0 P0 Hmt IH Hcond]; intros x g A Hb; simpl in *.
  - inversion Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists m0. split; [left; reflexivity | exact Hcond].
    + destruct (IH x g A Hin) as [m [Hm Hc]]. exists m. split; [right; exact Hm | exact Hc].
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_meet_ctx_top : forall (W:context) (P:econtext),
  meet_target W P -> q_Top <= q_C ->
  meet_target (meet_ctx_l q_C W) P.
Proof.
  intros W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; intros P Hmt Htop; simpl in *.
  - inversion Hmt; subst. apply mt_nil.
  - inversion Hmt as [|? ? m ? ? ? Hmt' Hcond]; subst.
    apply mt_cons with (g := q_C + g) (m := m).
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + intros _. eapply le_trans_g; [ apply le_qTop | exact Htop ].
Qed.

Lemma meet_target_self_meet : forall (W:context),
  meet_target W (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)).
Proof.
  intro W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - apply mt_nil.
  - apply mt_cons with (g := g) (m := q_C + g).
    + exact IH.
    + intros _. apply meet_C_lower.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_grade_meet_gen : forall (W:context) psi (a A:tm),
  Typing W psi a A -> uniq W -> psi <= q_C ->

  exists A' b, v = a_Abs psi0 A' b.
Variable canon_wsigma : forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
  exists a b, v = a_WPair a psi0 b.
Variable canon_ssigma : forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
  exists a b, v = a_SPair a psi0 b.
Variable canon_sum : forall psi (v:tm) A1 A2,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
  (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a).

Lemma Typing_progress_skeleton : forall psi a A,
  Typing nil psi a A -> (exists a', Step a a') \/ Value a.
Proof.
  intros psi a A H. induction H.
  1: { (* T_Type *) right. apply V_ValueType. apply ValueType_Type. }
  1: { (* T_Conv *) apply IHTyping1. }
  1: { (* T_Var *) exfalso. destruct H1. }

           * inversion Hval.

           * inversion Hval.

         + destruct Hval as [av| | | | | |]; try assumption; try inversion Hval; assumption.
         + apply Typing_lc in H1. exact H1. }
  1: { (* T_WSigma *) right. apply V_ValueType. eapply ValueType_WSigma.

  1: { (* T_WPair *) right. apply V_WPair.

  1: { (* T_SSigma *) right. apply V_ValueType. eapply ValueType_SSigma.

  1: { (* T_Inj1 *) right. apply V_Inj1. apply Typing_lc in H. exact H. }
  1: { (* T_Inj2 *) right. apply V_Inj2. apply Typing_lc in H. exact H. }

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.

AtomSetImpl.union_1
     : forall (s s' : atoms) (x : atom),
       x `in` union s s' -> x `in` s \/ x `in` s'
AtomSetImpl.union_2
     : forall (s s' : atoms) (x : atom), x `in` s -> x `in` union s s'

     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : AtomSetImpl.elt),
       y `in` add x s <-> x = y \/ y `in` s
AtomSetImpl.singleton_2
     : forall x y : atom, x = y -> y `in` singleton x
AtomSetProperties.FM.empty_iff
     : forall x : AtomSetImpl.elt, x `in` empty <-> False

AtomSetImpl.Equal
     : atoms -> atoms -> Prop

     : forall x y : atom, y `in` singleton x -> x = y
AtomSetImpl.add_1
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), x = y -> y `in` add x s
AtomSetImpl.add_2

Lemma Par_wpair_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b c,
  Par P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) c ->
  exists a' b', c = a_WPair a' psi0 b' /\
    ((a' = a /\ b' = b) \/ (CPar P psi psi0 a a' /\ Par P psi b b')).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b c H.
  remember (a_WPair a psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert a b E.
  induction H; intros a0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0, b0. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + left. split; reflexivity.
  - eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + right. split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_spair_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b c,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) c ->
  exists a' b', c = a_SPair a' psi0 b' /\
    ((a' = a /\ b' = b) \/ (CPar P psi psi0 a a' /\ Par P psi b b')).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b c H.
  remember (a_SPair a psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert a b E.
  induction H; intros a0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0, b0. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + left. split; reflexivity.
  - eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + right. split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_inj1_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi a c,
  Par P psi (a_Inj1 a) c ->
  exists a', c = a_Inj1 a' /\ (a' = a \/ Par P psi a a').
Proof.
  intros P psi a c H.
  remember (a_Inj1 a) as t eqn:E. revert a E.
  induction H; intros a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + left; reflexivity.
  - eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + right; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_inj2_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi a c,
  Par P psi (a_Inj2 a) c ->
  exists a', c = a_Inj2 a' /\ (a' = a \/ Par P psi a a').
Proof.
  intros P psi a c H.
  remember (a_Inj2 a) as t eqn:E. revert a E.
  induction H; intros a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + left; reflexivity.
  - eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + right; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_proj1_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) c ->
  (c = a_Proj1 psi0 a) \/
  (exists a', c = a_Proj1 psi0 a' /\ Par P psi a a' /\ psi0 <= psi) \/
  (exists a1' a2, c = a1' /\ Par P psi a (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a c H.
  remember (a_Proj1 psi0 a) as t eqn:E. revert a E.
  induction H; intros a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. right. exists a1', a2. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
  - right. left. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_proj2_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a c,

Qed.

Inductive LetPair_shape (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 c:tm) : Prop :=
 | LP_refl :
     c = a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1 ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c
 | LP_beta : forall (L2:vars) (a1':tm) (a2':tm) (b2:tm),
     c = a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a1') q_Bot a2' ->
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->
     (forall x, x `notin` L2 -> Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c
 | LP_cong : forall (L2:vars) (a2:tm) (b2:tm),
     c = a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2 ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     (forall x, x `notin` L2 -> Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c.

Lemma Par_letpair_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a1 b1 c,
  Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) c -> LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a1 b1 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply LP_refl. reflexivity.
  - match goal with
    | Hfam : forall x, x `notin` ?L -> _ |- _ =>
        eapply LP_beta with (L2 := L); [ reflexivity | eassumption | eassumption ]
    end.
  - match goal with
    | Hfam : forall x, x `notin` ?L -> _ |- _ =>
        eapply LP_cong with (L2 := L); [ reflexivity | eassumption | eassumption ]
    end.
Qed.

Inductive Case_shape (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 c:tm) : Prop :=
 | PC_refl :
     c = a_Case psi0 a b1 b2 ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_beta1 : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_App b1' psi0 a' ->
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_beta2 : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_App b2' psi0 a' ->
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_cong : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2' ->
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c.

Lemma Par_case_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b1 b2 c,
  Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) c -> Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply PC_refl. reflexivity.
  - eapply PC_beta1; try reflexivity; eassumption.
  - eapply PC_beta2; try reflexivity; eassumption.
  - eapply PC_cong; try reflexivity; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_app_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 f b c,
  Par P psi (a_App f psi0 b) c ->
  (c = a_App f psi0 b) \/
  (exists A a' b', c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi f (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b') \/
  (exists f' b', c = a_App f' psi0 b' /\ Par P psi f f' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 f b c H.
  remember (a_App f psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert f b E.
  induction H; intros f0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. left. eexists. eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
  - right. right. eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_rename_mid : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), GEq P psi a b ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) z gr x,
    P = C ++ (z,gr)::Q ->
    x `notin` dom (C ++ Q) ->
    GEq (C ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z a) (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b).
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (GEq_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:GEq P psi a b) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (z:atom) gr (x:atom),
         P = C ++ (z,gr)::Q -> x `notin` dom (C ++ Q) ->
         GEq (C ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi
           (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z a) (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b))
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall (C Q:econtext) (z:atom) gr (x:atom),
         P = C ++ (z,gr)::Q -> x `notin` dom (C ++ Q) ->
         CEq (C ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi phi0
           (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z a) (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b))).
  { (* GEq_Var *) intros P psi y psi0 u bn le C Q z gr x Heq Hx. subst P.
       destruct (eq_var y z) as [Hyz|Hyz].
       - subst y. rewrite !subst_var_same.
         assert (Hgr : psi0 = gr).
         { eapply (@uniq_binds_det (C ++ (z,gr)::Q) z psi0 gr u).
           - exact bn.
           - apply in_or_app. right. left. reflexivity. }
         subst psi0.
         eapply GEq_Var.
         + apply (@uniq_insert_mid C Q x gr (uniq_remove_mid C z gr Q u) Hx).
         + apply in_or_app. right. left. reflexivity.
         + exact le.
       - rewrite (@subst_var_neq (a_Var_f x) z y (fun H => Hyz (Logic.eq_sym H))).
         eapply GEq_Var.
         + apply (@uniq_insert_mid C Q x gr (uniq_remove_mid C z gr Q u) Hx).
         + apply In_cons_weaken.
           eapply binds_remove_mid; [ exact bn | exact Hyz ].
         + exact le. }
  { (* GEq_Type *) intros P psi s u C Q z gr x Heq Hx. subst P.
       apply GEq_Type.
       apply (@uniq_insert_mid C Q x gr (uniq_remove_mid C z gr Q u) Hx). }
  { (* GEq_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 g IHg fam IHfam C Q z gr x Heq Hx. subst P.
       eapply GEq_Pi with (L := L \u {{z}} \u {{x}}).
       - apply (IHg C Q z gr x); [ reflexivity | exact Hx ].
       - intros z0 nz. apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzz nzx].
         assert (Hzz0 : z0 <> z)
           by (intro H'; apply nzz; subst z0; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
         assert (Hz0x : z0 <> x)
           by (intro H'; apply nzx; subst z0; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
         assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom (((z0,psi)::C) ++ Q)).
         { apply notin_dom_cons_cons; [ exact Hx | exact (fun H => Hz0x (Logic.eq_sym H)) ]. }
         pose proof (IHfam z0 nzL ((z0,psi)::C) Q z gr x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hz.
         change (GEq (((z0,psi)::C) ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z B1) (a_Var_f z0))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z B2) (a_Var_f z0))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B1 z0 z (a_Var_f x) (lc_a_Var_f x) Hzz0).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open B2 z0 z (a_Var_f x) (lc_a_Var_f x) Hzz0).
         exact Hz. }
  { (* GEq_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 fam IHfam c IHc C Q z gr x Heq Hx. subst P.
       eapply GEq_Abs with (L := L \u {{z}} \u {{x}}).
       - intros z0 nz. apply notin_union_inv in nz. destruct nz as [nzL nzrest].
         apply notin_union_inv in nzrest. destruct nzrest as [nzz nzx].
         assert (Hzz0 : z0 <> z)
           by (intro H'; apply nzz; subst z0; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
         assert (Hz0x : z0 <> x)
           by (intro H'; apply nzx; subst z0; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
         assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom (((z0,psi0)::C) ++ Q)).
         { apply notin_dom_cons_cons; [ exact Hx | exact (fun H => Hz0x (Logic.eq_sym H)) ]. }
         pose proof (IHfam z0 nzL ((z0,psi0)::C) Q z gr x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hz.
         change (GEq (((z0,psi0)::C) ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b1) (a_Var_f z0))
                   (open_tm_wrt_tm (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b2) (a_Var_f z0))).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b1 z0 z (a_Var_f x) (lc_a_Var_f x) Hzz0).
         rewrite <- (@subst_open b2 z0 z (a_Var_f x) (lc_a_Var_f x) Hzz0).
         exact Hz.
       - apply (IHc C Q z gr x); [ reflexivity | exact Hx ]. }
  { (* GEq_App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 g IHg c IHc C Q z gr x Heq Hx. subst P.
       eapply GEq_App.

Lemma labels_app : forall (W1 W2:context), labels (W1 ++ W2) = labels W1 ++ labels W2.
Proof. intros; unfold labels. rewrite map_app. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma labels_cons : forall x psi (A:tm) (W:context),
  labels ((x ~ (psi, A)) ++ W) = (x ~ psi) ++ labels W.
Proof. intros; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma uniq_labels : forall (W:context), uniq W -> uniq (labels W).
Proof.
  intros W H. unfold labels.
  eapply uniq_map. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_labels : forall (W:context) x (psi:grade) (A:tm),
  binds x (psi,A) W -> binds x psi (labels W).
Proof.
  intros W x psi A H. induction W as [|[y [g B]] W IH].
  - simpl in H. destruct H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma labels_nil : labels (nil:context) = nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_labels : forall (W:context), dom (labels W) [=] dom W.
Proof.
  intro W. unfold labels. apply dom_map.
Qed.

(* ====================================================================== *)
(* Context insertion (a single fresh binder, at an arbitrary position)    *)
(* ====================================================================== *)

Inductive ins1 (y:tmvar) : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | ins1_nil : ins1 y nil nil
 | ins1_keep : forall (x:tmvar) (g:grade) (A:tm) (W Y:context),
     ins1 y W Y -> ins1 y (x ~ (g,A) ++ W) (x ~ (g,A) ++ Y)
 | ins1_add : forall (g:grade) (B:tm) (W Y:context),
     ins1 y W Y -> y `notin` dom Y -> ins1 y W (y ~ (g,B) ++ Y).

Lemma ins1_refl : forall (y:tmvar) (W:context), ins1 y W W.
Proof.
  intros y W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - apply ins1_nil.
  - apply ins1_keep. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma ins1_binds : forall (y:tmvar) (W Y:context), ins1 y W Y ->
  forall (x:tmvar) g (A:tm), binds x (g,A) W -> binds x (g,A) Y.
Proof.
  intros y W Y H. induction H; intros x g A Hb; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. exact Heq.
    + right. apply IH; exact Hin.
  - right. apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma ins1_dom_sub : forall (y:tmvar) (W Y:context), ins1 y W Y ->
  forall z, z `in` dom Y -> z `in` dom W \/ z = y.
Proof.
  intros y W Y H. induction H; intros z Hz; simpl in *.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.empty_iff in Hz. destruct Hz.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff. left. exact Heq.
    + apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Heq].
      * left. apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff. right. exact Hin.
      * right. exact Heq.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Heq|Hin].
    + right. exact Heq.
    + apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Heq].
      * left. exact Hin.
      * right. exact Heq.
Qed.

Lemma ins1_uniq : forall (y:tmvar) (W Y:context), ins1 y W Y ->
  uniq W -> y `notin` dom W -> uniq Y.
Proof.
  intros y W Y H. induction H; intros Hu Hy.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst.
    apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IHH; assumption.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot.
      destruct (ins1_dom_sub (ins1 := H) Hin) as [HinW|Heq].
      * exact HinW.
      * subst x. exact Hy.
  - apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IHH; assumption.
    + exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma ins1_meet_ctx_l : forall (y:tmvar) (W Y:context), ins1 y W Y ->
  ins1 y (meet_ctx_l q_C W) (meet_ctx_l q_C Y).
Proof.
  intros y W Y H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply ins1_nil.
  - apply ins1_keep. exact IH.
  - apply ins1_add.
    + exact IH.
    + change (y `notin` dom (meet_ctx_l q_C Y)).
      erewrite dom_meet_ctx_l. exact H0.
Qed.

Inductive ectx_ins1 (y:tmvar) : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | eins1_nil : ectx_ins1 y nil nil
 | eins1_keep : forall (x:tmvar) (g:grade) (P P':econtext),
     ectx_ins1 y P P' -> ectx_ins1 y (x ~ g ++ P) (x ~ g ++ P')
 | eins1_add : forall (g:grade) (P P':econtext),
     ectx_ins1 y P P' -> y `notin` dom P' -> ectx_ins1 y P (y ~ g ++ P').

Lemma ectx_ins1_refl : forall (y:tmvar) (P:econtext), ectx_ins1 y P P.
Proof.
  intros y P. induction P as [|[x g] P IH]; simpl.
  - apply eins1_nil.
  - apply eins1_keep. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma ectx_ins1_binds : forall (y:tmvar) (P P':econtext), ectx_ins1 y P P' ->
  forall (x:tmvar) g, binds x g P -> binds x g P'.
Proof.
  intros y P P' H. induction H; intros x g Hb; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hb.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. exact Heq.
    + right. apply IH; exact Hin.
  - right. apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma ectx_ins1_dom_sub : forall (y:tmvar) (P P':econtext), ectx_ins1 y P P' ->
  forall z, z `in` dom P' -> z `in` dom P \/ z = y.
Proof.
  intros y P P' H. induction H; intros z Hz; simpl in *.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.empty_iff in Hz. destruct Hz.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Heq|Hin].
    + left. apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff. left. exact Heq.
    + apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Heq].
      * left. apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff. right. exact Hin.
      * right. exact Heq.
  - apply AtomSetProperties.FM.add_iff in Hz. destruct Hz as [Heq|Hin].
    + right. exact Heq.
    + apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Heq]; [left exact Hin|right exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma ectx_ins1_uniq : forall (y:tmvar) (P P':econtext), ectx_ins1 y P P' ->
  uniq P -> y `notin` dom P -> uniq P'.
Proof.
  intros y P P' H. induction H; intros Hu Hy.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst.
    apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IHH; assumption.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot.
      destruct (ectx_ins1_dom_sub (ectx_ins1 := H) Hin) as [HinP|Heq].
      * exact HinP.
      * subst x. exact Hy.
  - apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IHH; assumption.
    + exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma ectx_ins1_meet_labels : forall (y:tmvar) (W Y:context), ins1 y W Y ->
  ectx_ins1 y (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)) (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C Y)).
Proof.
  intros y W Y H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply eins1_nil.
  - apply eins1_keep. exact IH.
  - apply eins1_add.
    + exact IH.
    + change (y `notin` dom (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C Y))).
      rewrite dom_labels. erewrite dom_meet_ctx_l. exact H0.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_grade_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros P psi phi0 a H Hle. destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 ip Hg|P0 ph ph0 a0 l n u].
  - exact Hg.
  - exfalso. apply n. exact Hle. Qed.

Lemma le_bot : forall psi:grade, q_Bot <= psi.
Proof.
  intro psi. apply leq_meet. rewrite meet_comm. apply meet_Bot_r.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ Grade P psi a) \/ (lc_tm a /\ ~ (phi0 <= psi)).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H.
  destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 ip Hg|P0 ph ph0 a0 lc n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open_cgrade : forall (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  lc_tm s -> CGrade Q psi psi0 s ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b s).
Proof.
  intros Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc Hc Hfam.
  destruct (CGrade_cases Hc) as [[Hle Hg]|[Hlc' Hnle]].
  - apply (@Grade_open Q psi psi0 b L s Hg Hfam).
  - apply (@Grade_open_lc Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc' Hnle Hfam).
Qed.

Lemma Grade_abs_fam : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (A b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) ->
  exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof. intros. inversion H. eexists. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_cgrade : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_snd : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_spair_cgrade : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_spair_snd : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_inj1_fst : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_inj2_fst : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

(* ---------------- every Par-reduct is Gradeable ---------------- *)

Lemma Par_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  refine (@Par_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:Par P psi a b) => Grade P psi b)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) => CGrade P psi phi0 b)

Lemma GEq_CEq : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),

    ectx_ins1 y P P' -> y `notin` dom P -> uniq P' -> CGrade P' psi phi0 a.

  - intros y P' Hr Hy Hu. eapply CG_Nleq.
    + exact l.
    + exact n.
    + exact Hu.

 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2

     lc_tm a1 ->

      uniq  P  ->

      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)

Lemma Par_abs_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A a b,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) b ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' a', b = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\
    ((A' = A /\ a' = a) \/
     (CPar P psi q_Top A A' /\
      forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi0) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a b Hpar.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as t eqn:E.
  revert A a E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, a0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

Proof.

Lemma Par_wpair_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b c,
  Par P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) c ->
  exists a' b', c = a_WPair a' psi0 b' /\
    ((a' = a /\ b' = b) \/ (CPar P psi psi0 a a' /\ Par P psi b b')).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b c H.
  remember (a_WPair a psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert a b E.
  induction H; intros a0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists a0, b0. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + left. split; reflexivity.
  - eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + right. split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_proj1_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) c ->
  (c = a_Proj1 psi0 a) \/
  (exists a', c = a_Proj1 psi0 a' /\ Par P psi a a' /\ psi0 <= psi) \/

Inductive LetPair_shape (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 c:tm) : Prop :=
 | LP_refl :
     c = a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1 ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c
 | LP_beta : forall (L2:vars) (a1':tm) (a2':tm) (b2:tm),
     c = a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a1') q_Bot a2' ->
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->
     (forall x, x `notin` L2 -> Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c
 | LP_cong : forall (L2:vars) (a2:tm) (b2:tm),
     c = a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2 ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     (forall x, x `notin` L2 -> Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
     LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c.

Lemma Par_letpair_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a1 b1 c,
  Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) c -> LetPair_shape P psi psi0 a1 b1 c.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a1 b1 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply LP_refl. reflexivity.
  - match goal with
    | Hfam : forall x, x `notin` ?L -> _ |- _ =>
        eapply LP_beta with (L2 := L); [ reflexivity | eassumption | eassumption ]
    end.
  - match goal with
    | Hfam : forall x, x `notin` ?L -> _ |- _ =>
        eapply LP_cong with (L2 := L); [ reflexivity | eassumption | eassumption ]
    end.
Qed.

Inductive Case_shape (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 c:tm) : Prop :=
 | PC_refl :
     c = a_Case psi0 a b1 b2 ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_beta1 : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_App b1' psi0 a' ->
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_beta2 : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_App b2' psi0 a' ->
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c
 | PC_cong : forall (a':tm) (b1':tm) (b2':tm),
     c = a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2' ->
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
     psi0 <= psi ->
     Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c.

Lemma Par_case_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b1 b2 c,
  Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) c -> Case_shape P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c.
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply PC_refl. reflexivity.
  - eapply PC_beta1; try reflexivity; eassumption.
  - eapply PC_beta2; try reflexivity; eassumption.
  - eapply PC_cong; try reflexivity; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_app_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 f b c,
  Par P psi (a_App f psi0 b) c ->
  (c = a_App f psi0 b) \/
  (exists A a' b', c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi f (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b') \/
  (exists f' b', c = a_App f' psi0 b' /\ Par P psi f f' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 f b c H.
  remember (a_App f psi0 b) as t eqn:E. revert f b E.
  induction H; intros f0 b0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. left. eexists. eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
  - right. right. eexists. eexists. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma CEq_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm), CEq P psi phi0 a b ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ GEq P psi a b) \/
  (~ (phi0 <= psi) /\ lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ uniq P).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 i g|P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 la lb n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [ exact n | split; [ exact la | split; assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma GEq_var_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi x y,

Lemma open_close_subst_gen : forall (E:tm) n z x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n z E)
  = subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros n z x.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHB (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHb (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_lt m n z Hlt). rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m n (a_Var_f x) Hlt).
      simpl. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_ge m n z Hge).
---
Lemma subst_open_var_fresh : forall (B:tm) z x,
  z `notin` fv_tm_tm B ->
  subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z))
  = open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x).
Proof.
  intros B z x Hfv. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm.
  apply (@subst_open_var_gen B 0 z x Hfv).
Qed.

Proof.

  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs.

Proof.

Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi t, Grade P psi t -> GEq P psi t t.
Proof.
  intros P psi t H.
  apply (Grade_mut (fun P psi t d => GEq P psi t t)
                   (fun P psi phi0 t d => CEq P psi phi0 t t)).
  - intros. apply GEq_Type. assumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Var; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_Pi. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A b g IH c IHc.
    eapply GEq_Abs. intros x Hx. apply IH. exact Hx. exact IHc.
  - intros. eapply GEq_App; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_WSigma. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros. eapply GEq_WPair; eassumption.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 a c g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_LetPair. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_SSigma. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros. eapply GEq_SPair; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Sum; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Case; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TyUnit; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TmUnit; eassumption.
  - intros P1 phi phi0 a Hle g IH. apply CEq_Leq; assumption.
  - intros. eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a,
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. destruct H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [ assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption ].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.

Ltac inv_grade_inj :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_Inj1 ?a) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac inv_grade_inj2 :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_Inj2 ?a) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac inv_grade_wpair :=
  match goal with
  | H : Grade ?P ?ps (a_WPair ?a ?ps0 ?b) |- _ => inversion H; subst
  end.
Ltac par_family :=
  intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; eauto.

Lemma Step_par : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hg Hstep. revert Hg.
  induction Hstep; intros Hg.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_App.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + apply CGrade_CPar_refl. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply CGrade_CPar_refl. eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst.
    eapply Par_Case.
    + eapply IHHstep. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst. inv_grade_inj.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + apply Par_Refl. eassumption.

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->

 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),

      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->

 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),

     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->

| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),

Lemma dom_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context), dom (meet_ctx_l psi W) [=] dom W.
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.

Lemma uniq_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context),
  uniq W -> uniq (meet_ctx_l psi W).
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; intros H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - inversion H as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- dom_meet_ctx_l. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma binds_meet_ctx_l : forall (psi:grade) (W:context) (x:tmvar) g (A:tm),
  binds x (g,A) W -> binds x (psi + g, A) (meet_ctx_l psi W).
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[y [gy Ay]] W IH]; intros x g A H; simpl in *.
  - destruct H.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
  intros W x psi A H. induction W as [|[y [g B]] W IH].
  - simpl in H. destruct H.
  - simpl in H. simpl. destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

(* ================= Goal A: one-step parallel simulation ================= *)

Lemma GEq_par_dia : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), GEq P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ GEq P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros PP ps a0 b0 H.
  apply (GEq_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:GEq P psi a b) =>
       forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ GEq P psi c d)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi phi0 b d /\ CEq P psi phi0 c d)).
  { (* Var *) intros P psi y psi0 u0 bn le c Hpar.
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    exists (a_Var_f y). split.
    - apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_Var P psi y psi0 u0 bn le))).
    - apply GEq_Var; assumption. }
  { (* Type *) intros P psi s u0 c Hpar.
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    exists (a_Type s). split.
    - apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_Type P psi s u0))).
    - apply GEq_Type; assumption. }
  { (* Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 hA IHhA fam IHfam c Hpar.
    destruct (Par_pi_inv Hpar) as [L2 [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]]].
    destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
    - subst A1'. subst B1'. rewrite Heq.
      exists (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2). split.
      + apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_Pi L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 hA fam))).
      + apply GEq_Pi; assumption.
    - rewrite Heq.
      destruct (IHhA A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].
      set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm B2 \u fv_tm_tm B1' \u dom P).
      destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz]. unfold Ltot in Hz.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [HzB2 Hzr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr3. destruct Hzr3 as [HzB1' Hzdom].
      destruct (IHfam z HzL (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) (Hpb z HzL2))
        as [dz [HdzB2 HdzB1']].
      pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
      assert (HParFam : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
                Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
      { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
        apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
        pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB2
                      nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
        rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B2 z x HxB2) in Hren.
        rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
        unfold body. exact Hren. }
      assert (HGEqFam : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
                GEq ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
      { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
        apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
        pose proof (@GEq_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB1'
                      nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
        rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B1' z x HxB1') in Hren.
        rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
        unfold body. exact Hren. }
      exists (a_Pi psi0 dA body). split.
      + eapply Par_Pi with (L := Ltot); [ exact HA2 | exact HParFam ].
      + eapply GEq_Pi with (L := Ltot); [ exact HA1' | exact HGEqFam ]. }
  { (* Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 fam IHfam hceq IHc c Hpar.

    destruct HD as [[HA Hb]|[Hcpar Hpb]].
    - subst A1'. subst b1'. rewrite Heq.
      exists (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2). split.
      + apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_Abs L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 fam hceq))).
      + apply GEq_Abs; assumption.
    - rewrite Heq.
      destruct (IHc A1' Hcpar) as [dA [HCPar2 HCEq1]].
      set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm b2 \u fv_tm_tm b1' \u dom P).
      destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz]. unfold Ltot in Hz.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [Hzb2 Hzr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hzr3. destruct Hzr3 as [Hzb1' Hzdom].
      destruct (IHfam z HzL (open_tm_wrt_tm b1' (a_Var_f z)) (Hpb z HzL2))
        as [dz [Hdzb2 Hdzb1']].
      pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
      assert (HParFam : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
                Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
      { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
        apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [Hxb2 Hxr3].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [Hxb1' Hxdom].
        pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi0)::P) psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f z)) dz Hdzb2
                      nil P z psi0 x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
        rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh b2 z x Hxb2) in Hren.
        rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
        unfold body. exact Hren. }
      assert (HGEqFam : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
                GEq ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1' (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
      { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
        apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [Hxb2 Hxr3].
        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [Hxb1' Hxdom].
        pose proof (@GEq_rename_mid ((z,psi0)::P) psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm b1' (a_Var_f z)) dz Hdzb1'
                      nil P z psi0 x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
        rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh b1' z x Hxb1') in Hren.
        rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
        unfold body. exact Hren. }
      exists (a_Abs psi0 dA body). split.
      + eapply Par_Abs with (L := Ltot); [ exact HParFam | exact HCPar2 ].
      + eapply GEq_Abs with (L := Ltot); [ exact HGEqFam | exact HCEq1 ]. }
  { (* App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 hf IHhf ha IHha c Hpar.
    destruct (Par_app_cases Hpar) as [Heq|[A [a' [b' [Heq [Hfabs Hcpar]]]]]|[f' [b' [Heq [Hf Hcpar]]]]].
    - rewrite Heq.
      exists (a_App b2 psi0 a2). split.
      + apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_App P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 hf ha))).
      + apply GEq_App; assumption.
    - destruct (IHhf (a_Abs psi0 A a') Hfabs) as [dAbs [HParAbs HGEqAbs]].
      destruct (GEq_abs_inv HGEqAbs) as [LA [A2' [b2body [Heqabs [HfamAbs HceqA]]]]].
      destruct (IHha b' Hcpar) as [darg [HCParArg HCEqArg]].

      rewrite Heq.
      exists (open_tm_wrt_tm b2body darg). split.
      + eapply Par_AppBeta; [ exact HParAbs | exact HCParArg ].
      + exact (@GEq_open2_CEq P psi psi0 a' b2body LA b' darg HfamAbs HCEqArg).
    - destruct (IHhf f' Hf) as [df [HPar_f HGEq_f]].
      destruct (IHha b' Hcpar) as [darg [HCParArg HCEqArg]].
      rewrite Heq.

      + eapply Par_App; [ exact HPar_f | exact HCParArg ].
      + eapply GEq_App; [ exact HGEq_f | exact HCEqArg ]. }
  { (* WSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 hA IHhA fam IHfam c Hpar.
    destruct (Par_wsigma_inv Hpar) as [L2 [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]]].
    destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
    - subst A1'. subst B1'. rewrite Heq.
      exists (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2). split.
      + apply Par_Refl. apply (proj2 (GEq_grade (GEq_WSigma L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 hA fam))).

    - rewrite Heq.
      destruct (IHhA A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].

      destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz]. unfold Ltot in Hz.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].

        apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].

      assert (HGEqFam : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->

      { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.

Lemma binds_labels_inv : forall (W:context) x g,
  binds x g (labels W) -> exists A, binds x (g,A) W.
Proof.

dom (subst_ctx u x W) [=] dom W.
Proof.
  intros u x W. induction W as [|[y [g A]] W IH]; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite IH; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma uniq_subst_ctx : forall (u:tm) x (W:context),
  uniq W -> uniq (subst_ctx u x W).
Proof.
  intros u x W. induction W as [|[y [g A]] W IH]; intros Hu; simpl in *.
  - exact Hu.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite <- dom_subst_ctx. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma meet_ctx_subst_ctx : forall psi (u:tm) x (W:context),
  meet_ctx_l psi (subst_ctx u x W) = subst_ctx u x (meet_ctx_l psi W).
Proof.
  intros psi u x W. induction W as [|[y [g A]] W IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.
Section ProgressFromCanon.
From Stdlib Require Import Program.Equality.

Variable canon_pi : forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
  exists A' b, v = a_Abs psi0 A' b.
Variable canon_wsigma : forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
  exists a b, v = a_WPair a psi0 b.
Variable canon_ssigma : forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
  exists a b, v = a_SPair a psi0 b.
Variable canon_sum : forall psi (v:tm) A1 A2,
  Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
  (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a).

Lemma Typing_progress_from_canon : forall psi a A,
  Typing nil psi a A -> (exists a', Step a a') \/ Value a.
Proof.
  intros psi a A H. dependent induction H.
  1: { (* T_Type *) right. apply V_ValueType. apply ValueType_Type. }
  1: { (* T_Conv *) apply IHTyping1; exact (JMeq_refl nil). }
  1: { (* T_Var *) exfalso. simpl in H1. destruct H1. }
  1: { (* T_Pi *) right. apply V_ValueType. eapply ValueType_Pi.
       - exact (@Typing_lc nil psi A (a_Type s1) H).
       - constructor; [ exact (@Typing_lc nil psi A (a_Type s1) H) | ].
         apply (@lc_open_all L B). intros x Hx.
         exact (@Typing_lc (x ~ (psi,A) ++ nil) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s2) (H0 x Hx)). }
  1: { (* T_Abs *) right. apply V_Abs.
       - eapply lc_tm_Pi_fst.
         exact (@Typing_lc (meet_ctx_l q_C nil) q_C (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) H1).
       - constructor.
         + eapply lc_tm_Pi_fst.
           exact (@Typing_lc (meet_ctx_l q_C nil) q_C (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) H1).
         + apply (@lc_open_all L b). intros x Hx.
           exact (@Typing_lc (x ~ (q_join psi0 psi,A) ++ nil) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (H x Hx)). }
  1: { (* T_App *) specialize (IHTyping1 (JMeq_refl nil));
         destruct IHTyping1 as [[f' Hstep]|Hval].
       - left. exists (a_App f' psi0 a). eapply S_AppCong.
         + apply Typing_lc in H0. exact H0.
         + exact Hstep.

(* ---------------- locally closed characterization ---------------- *)

Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs psi A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Type s => True
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => lc_at k A1 /\ lc_at k A2

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

     CTyping W psi a A

Inductive Value : tm -> Prop :=
 | V_ValueType : forall (a:tm),
     ValueType a ->
     Value a
 | V_TmUnit :
     Value a_TmUnit
 | V_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs psi A a)
 | V_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->

 | V_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),

      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),

with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),

     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),

  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.

(* ---------------- type-constructor tags ---------------- *)

Inductive ttag : Set :=
 | TType | TTyUnit | TPi | TWSigma | TSSigma | TSum.

Definition ctag (t:tm) : option ttag :=
  match t with
  | a_Type _ => Some TType
  | a_TyUnit => Some TTyUnit
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => Some TPi
  | a_WSigma _ _ _ => Some TWSigma
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => Some TSSigma
  | a_Sum _ _ => Some TSum
  | _ => None
  end.

Lemma Par_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht.
  - exact Ht.
  - eauto using Par_ctag.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctag_Type : forall s, ctag (a_Type s) = Some TType.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a b Hpar.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as t eqn:E.

Lemma uniq_meet_inv : forall (psi:grade) (W:context),
  uniq (meet_ctx_l psi W) -> uniq W.
Proof.
  intros psi W. induction W as [|[x [g A]] W IH]; intros Hu; simpl in *.
  - exact Hu.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst. apply uniq_cons.
    + apply IH; exact Htail.
    + intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite dom_meet_ctx_l. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_uniq : forall (W:context) psi (a A:tm), Typing W psi a A -> uniq W.
Proof.
  intros W psi a A H. induction H.
  all: try assumption.
  all: try (match goal with Hm : uniq (meet_ctx_l ?p ?W0) |- uniq ?W0 => exact (@uniq_meet_inv p W0 Hm) end).
Qed.

Lemma Typing_meet_ctx : forall (W:context) psi (a A:tm),
  Typing W psi a A -> psi <= q_C -> Typing (meet_ctx_l q_C W) psi a A.
Proof.
  intros W psi a A H Hle.
  apply (@Typing_meet_rel W psi a A H (meet_ctx_l q_C W)).
  apply (@ctx_meet_rel_self W).
  exact (@Typing_uniq W psi a A H).
Qed.

Lemma binds_labels_inv : forall (W:context) x g,
  binds x g (labels W) -> exists A, binds x (g,A) W.
Proof.
  intros W. induction W as [|[y [gy Ay]] W IH]; intros x g Hb; simpl in Hb.
  - destruct Hb.

Lemma binds_labels_meet_le : forall (W:context) x g,

Lemma Rctx_labels_grade_rel : forall p p' (W W':context),
  Rctx p p' W W' -> uniq W ->
  grade_rel q_C (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)) (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W')).
Proof.
  intros p p' W W' H Huniq. split.
  - rewrite dom_labels. rewrite dom_labels.
    rewrite dom_meet_ctx_l. rewrite dom_meet_ctx_l.
    exact (@Rctx_dom p p' W W' H).
  - split.

  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
end.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm_tm a x A))).

Definition join_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi * g, A)).

Definition join_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g * psi, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi + g, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g + psi, A)).

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b)
 | G_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a c:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)
 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b)
 | G_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a)
 | G_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)
 | G_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
     Grade P psi B ->
     Grade P psi (a_Sum A B)
 | G_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm),
     Grade P psi a1 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a1)

Lemma Par_diamond : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (Par_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:Par P psi a b) =>
       forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi phi0 b d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d)).
  all: try solve
    [ exact Par_dia_refl
    | exact Par_dia_pi
    | exact Par_dia_wsigma
    | exact Par_dia_ssigma
    | exact Par_dia_abs
    | exact Par_dia_sum
    | exact Par_dia_inj1
    | exact Par_dia_inj2
    | exact Par_dia_wpair
    | exact Par_dia_spair
    | exact Par_dia_appbeta
    | exact Par_dia_app
    | exact Par_dia_wpairbeta
    | exact Par_dia_letpair
    | exact Par_dia_proj1beta
    | exact Par_dia_proj1
    | exact Par_dia_proj2beta
    | exact Par_dia_proj2
    | exact Par_dia_casebeta1
    | exact Par_dia_casebeta2
    | exact Par_dia_case
    | exact Par_dia_cpar_leq
    | exact Par_dia_cpar_nleq ].
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ---------------- multi-step parallel reduction: composition and confluence ---------------- *)

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
  - apply GEq_sym. exact geq.
Qed.
