  1: { (* Eq_Refl *) intros P psi a g. split; exact g. }
  1: { (* Eq_Trans *) intros P psi a c b d IHd d0 IHd0.
       destruct IHd as [Ga Gb]. destruct IHd0 as [Gb' Gc]. split; assumption. }
  1: { (* Eq_Sym *) intros P psi b a d IHd. destruct IHd as [Ga Gb]. split; assumption. }

         + intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb1.
         + exact CA1.
       - eapply G_Abs.
         + intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb2.
         + exact CA2. }
  1: { (* Eq_App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 d IHd c IHc.
       destruct IHd as [Gb1 Gb2]. destruct IHc as [Ca1 Ca2]. split.
       - eapply G_App; [ exact Gb1 | exact Ca1 ].

 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a1' a2:tm),

     Par P psi b2 b2' ->

     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2').

Lemma Par_dia_wpair : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2,
  CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a1 c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 a2 d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d) ->
  Par P psi b1 b2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi b1 c -> exists d, Par P psi b2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 dA IHdA dB IHdB c H2.
  destruct (Par_wpair_inv H2) as [a1' [b1' [Heq HD]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hcpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHdA a1' Hcpa) as [d1 [HA2 HA1']].
    destruct (IHdB b1' Hpb) as [d2 [HB2 HB1']].
    exists (a_WPair d1 psi0 d2). split.
    + eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_spair : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2,

  Par P psi b1 b2 ->

    exists (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHdA a1' Hcpa) as [d1 [HA2 HA1']].
    destruct (IHdB b1' Hpb) as [d2 [HB2 HB1']].

Lemma Par_dia_pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2,
  Par P psi A1 A2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi A1 c -> exists d, Par P psi A2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> forall c,
      Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) c ->
      exists d, Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) d /\
                Par ((x,psi)::P) psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd fam IHfam c H2.
  destruct (Par_pi_inv H2) as [L2 [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].
    set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm B2 \u fv_tm_tm B1' \u dom P).
    destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz].
    unfold Ltot in Hz.
    apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [HzB2 Hzr3].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr3. destruct Hzr3 as [HzB1' Hzdom].
    destruct (IHfam z HzL (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) (Hpb z HzL2))
      as [dz [HdzB2 HdzB1']].
    pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
    assert (Hfam2 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
      pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB2
                    nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B2 z x HzB2) in Hren.
      rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
      unfold body. exact Hren. }
    assert (Hfam1 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
      pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB1'
                    nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B1' z x HzB1') in Hren.
      rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
      unfold body. exact Hren. }
    exists (a_Pi psi1 dA body). split.
    + eapply Par_Pi with (L := Ltot).
      * exact HA2.
      * exact Hfam2.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Pi with (L := Ltot).
      * exact HA1'.
      * exact Hfam1.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_wsigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2,

  intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd fam IHfam c H2.

  - destruct (IHd A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].
    set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm B2 \u fv_tm_tm B1' \u dom P).
    destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz]. unfold Ltot in Hz.
    apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [HzB2 Hzr3].

    pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
    assert (Hfam2 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (Par_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:Par P psi a b) =>
       forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi phi0 b d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d)).
  all: try solve
    [ exact Par_dia_refl
    | exact Par_dia_pi
    | exact Par_dia_wsigma
    | exact Par_dia_ssigma
    | exact Par_dia_abs
    | exact Par_dia_sum
    | exact Par_dia_inj1
    | exact Par_dia_inj2
    | exact Par_dia_wpair
    | exact Par_dia_spair
    | exact Par_dia_appbeta
    | exact Par_dia_app
    | exact Par_dia_wpairbeta
    | exact Par_dia_letpair
    | exact Par_dia_proj1beta
    | exact Par_dia_proj1
    | exact Par_dia_proj2beta
    | exact Par_dia_proj2
    | exact Par_dia_casebeta1
    | exact Par_dia_casebeta2
    | exact Par_dia_case
    | exact Par_dia_cpar_leq
    | exact Par_dia_cpar_nleq ].
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ---------------- multi-step parallel reduction: composition and confluence ---------------- *)

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
  - apply GEq_sym. exact geq.
Qed.

(* ---------------- shape facts for CEq and GEq ---------------- *)

Lemma CEq_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm), CEq P psi phi0 a b ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ GEq P psi a b) \/
  (~ (phi0 <= psi) /\ lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ uniq P).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 i g|P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 la lb n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [ exact n | split; [ exact la | split; assumption ] ].
Qed.

      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A

     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->

      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Export Qual.metalib.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Open Scope grade_scope.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.
Parameter sort : Set.

Parameter axiom : sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter rule_pi : sort -> sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter rule_sig : sort -> sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter star : sort.

Definition size_sort (s:sort) := 1.

Parameter sort_regularity : forall s1, exists s2, axiom s1 s2.
Require Import ssreflect.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Lemma Par_abs_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A a b,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) b ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' a', b = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\
    ((A' = A /\ a' = a) \/
     (CPar P psi q_Top A A' /\
      forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi0) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a b Hpar.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as t eqn:E.
  revert A a E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 a0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, a0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_pi_inv : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 A B c,
  Par P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) c ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' B', c = a_Pi psi0 A' B' /\
    ((A' = A /\ B' = B) \/ (Par P psi A A' /\ forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B c Hpar.
  remember (a_Pi psi0 A B) as t eqn:E.
  revert A B E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 B0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, B0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

  Par P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) c ->
  exists (L:atoms) A' B', c = a_WSigma psi0 A' B' /\
    ((A' = A /\ B' = B) \/ (Par P psi A A' /\ forall x, x \notin L -> Par ((x ~ psi) ++ P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x)))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B c Hpar.
  remember (a_WSigma psi0 A B) as t eqn:E.
  revert A B E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 B0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, B0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].
  - eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [ reflexivity | right; split ]; eassumption.
Qed.

  Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) c ->

Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B c Hpar.
  remember (a_SSigma psi0 A B) as t eqn:E.
  revert A B E.
  induction Hpar; intros A0 B0 E; inversion E; subst.
  - exists (AtomSetImpl.empty), A0, B0. split; [ reflexivity | left; auto ].

Proof.
  intros P psi A B c Hpar.

Lemma uniq_remove_mid : forall (C:econtext) x g (Q:econtext),
  uniq (C ++ (x,g)::Q) -> uniq (C ++ Q).
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[z gz] C IH]; intros x g Q H.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H as [|? ? ? Htail Hnot]; subst.
    apply uniq_cons.
    + eapply IH; exact Htail.
    + assert (Hz : z `notin` dom (C ++ Q)).
      { intro Hin. apply Hnot. rewrite dom_app.
        apply (proj1 (@dom_app _ C Q z)) in Hin.
        apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
        - apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hin.
        - apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. exact Hin. }
      exact Hz.
Qed.

  binds y gy (C ++ (x,gx)::Q) -> y <> x -> binds y gy (C ++ Q).
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|[z gz] C IH]; intros x gx Q y gy H Hne; simpl in *.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. contradiction.
    + exact Hin.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + left; exact Heq.
    + right; eapply IH; eassumption.
Qed.

Definition CanonSpec (v C:tm) : Prop :=
  (forall p X Y, C = a_Pi p X Y -> exists A' b, v = a_Abs p A' b) /\
  (forall p X Y, C = a_WSigma p X Y -> exists a b, v = a_WPair a p b) /\

  (forall X Y, C = a_Sum X Y ->
     (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a)).

Lemma canon_typing_spec : forall (W:context) psi (v A:tm),
  Value v -> Typing W psi v A ->
  CanonSpec v A /\
  (forall C, DefEq (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)) q_C A C -> CanonSpec v C).
Proof.
  intros W psi v A Hv Ht.
  revert Hv.
  dependent induction Ht; intros Hv.
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Type *)
  - split.                                          (* T_Conv *)
    + apply (proj2 (IHHt1 Hv)) with (C:=B); exact H.
    + intros C Hdef. apply (proj2 (IHHt1 Hv)) with (C:=C). eapply Eq_Trans; eassumption.
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_Var *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Pi *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Abs *)
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_App *)
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_AppIrrel *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_WSigma *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_WPair *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_WPairIrrel *)
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_LetPair *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_SSigma *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_SPair *)
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_Proj1 *)
  - val_absurd.                                     (* T_Proj2 *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Sum *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Inj1 *)
  - split; [solve_canon_own | solve_canon_conv].   (* T_Inj2 *)

Definition DefEq_VT_head_spec : Prop :=
  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
    DefEq P psi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b ->
    ctag a = ctag b /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_Pi p A B -> b = a_Pi q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_WSigma p A B -> b = a_WSigma q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_SSigma p A B -> b = a_SSigma q A' B' -> p = q).

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Canonical forms, conditional on DefEq_VT_head_spec.                   *)
(* These are the exact requested conclusions, with the single missing   *)
(* head-invariance principle for DefEq between ValueType terms as an    *)
(* explicit premise.                                                     *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma canon_pi_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
    exists A' b, v = a_Abs psi0 A' b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj1 H) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_wsigma_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
    exists a b, v = a_WPair a psi0 b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj1 H)) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_ssigma_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
    exists a b, v = a_SPair a psi0 b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj1 H))) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_sum_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) A1 A2,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
    (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a).
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v A1 A2 Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj1 H))) A1 A2). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Par_open : forall (P:econtext) psi g (b1 b2:tm) (L:atoms) (u v:tm),
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  CPar P psi g u v ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 v).
Proof.
  intros P psi g b1 b2 L u v Hfam Hcp.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) as [x Hx].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxrest].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hxrest. destruct Hxrest as [Hxfv1 Hxfv2].
  assert (HP : Par ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))).
  { apply Hfam; exact HxL. }
  pose (Hres := @Par_subst_var ((x,g)::P) psi
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)) HP
                 nil P x g u v Logic.eq_refl Hcp).
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b1 x u Hxfv1) in Hres.
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b2 x v Hxfv2) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Require Import Qual.typing.
From Stdlib Require Import Classical.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------------- locally closed characterization ---------------- *)

Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs psi A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Type s => True
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => lc_at k A1 /\ lc_at k A2
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case psi a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair psi a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 psi a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 psi a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall t j z,
  lc_at j (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec j (a_Var_f z) t) <-> lc_at (S j) t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; simpl; intros j z; try tauto.
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; split; intros; lia.
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - split.
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt3 j z) H3).
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt3 j z) H3).

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm_tm a x A))).

Definition join_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi * g, A)).

Definition join_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g * psi, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi + g, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g + psi, A)).

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1

     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b)
 | G_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a c:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)
 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b)
 | G_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a)
 | G_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)
 | G_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
     Grade P psi B ->
     Grade P psi (a_Sum A B)
 | G_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm),
     Grade P psi a1 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a1)
 | G_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2:tm),
     Grade P psi a2 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a2)
 | G_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi b1 ->
     Grade P psi b2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)
 | G_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TyUnit
 | G_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TmUnit.

Inductive CEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
with GEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GEq_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GEq_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GEq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | GEq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | GEq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     GEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | GEq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | GEq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     GEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | GEq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     GEq P psi a a' ->
     GEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     GEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | GEq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->

 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :

Scheme GEq_mut := Induction for GEq Sort Prop
  with CEq_mut := Induction for CEq Sort Prop.

Lemma GEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), GEq P psi a b -> GEq P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  apply (GEq_mut (fun P psi a b d => GEq P psi b a)
                 (fun P psi phi0 a b d => CEq P psi phi0 b a)).
  all: try (intros; match goal with
            | |- CEq _ _ _ _ _ => first [ eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption | fail 1 ]
            | _ => fail 1
            end).
  all: try (intros; econstructor; eauto).
  all: try assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------- type-constructor tags ---------------- *)

Inductive ttag : Set :=
 | TType | TTyUnit | TPi | TWSigma | TSSigma | TSum.

Definition ctag (t:tm) : option ttag :=
  match t with
  | a_Type _ => Some TType
  | a_TyUnit => Some TTyUnit
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => Some TPi
  | a_WSigma _ _ _ => Some TWSigma
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => Some TSSigma
  | a_Sum _ _ => Some TSum
  | _ => None
  end.

Lemma Par_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht.
  - exact Ht.
  - eauto using Par_ctag.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctag_Type : forall s, ctag (a_Type s) = Some TType.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->

 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),

(* ---------------- the parallel-reduction diamond ---------------- *)

Ltac diamond_intro :=
  match goal with
  | |- forall c, Par _ _ _ c -> _ => idtac
  | |- forall c, CPar _ _ _ _ c -> _ => idtac
  | |- forall x, _ => intro; diamond_intro
  | |- _ -> _ => intro; diamond_intro
  end.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (Par_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:Par P psi a b) =>
       forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi phi0 b d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d)).
  all: try solve
    [ exact Par_dia_refl
    | exact Par_dia_pi
    | exact Par_dia_wsigma
    | exact Par_dia_ssigma
    | exact Par_dia_abs
    | exact Par_dia_sum
    | exact Par_dia_inj1
    | exact Par_dia_inj2
    | exact Par_dia_wpair

(* ---------------- multi-step parallel reduction: composition and confluence ---------------- *)

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
  - apply GEq_sym. exact geq.
Qed.

Lemma CEq_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm), CEq P psi phi0 a b ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ GEq P psi a b) \/
  (~ (phi0 <= psi) /\ lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ uniq P).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 i g|P0 ph ph0 a0 b0 la lb n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [ exact n | split; [ exact la | split; assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma GEq_trans : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), GEq P psi a b ->
  forall c, GEq P psi b c -> GEq P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (GEq_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:GEq P psi a b) => forall c, GEq P psi b c -> GEq P psi a c)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) => forall c, CEq P psi phi0 b c -> CEq P psi phi0 a c)).
  1: { (* GEq_Var *) intros P psi x psi0 u b i c Hy.
       rewrite (GEq_var_inv Hy). eapply GEq_Var; eassumption. }
  1: { (* GEq_Type *) intros P psi s u c Hy.
       rewrite (GEq_type_inv Hy). eapply GEq_Type; eassumption. }
  1: { (* GEq_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 g IHg fam IHfam c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_pi_inv Hy) as [L2 [A3 [B3 [Heq [Hpar Hfam]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Pi with (L := L \u L2).
       - apply (IHg A3 Hpar).
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
         exact (IHfam x Hx1 (open_tm_wrt_tm B3 (a_Var_f x)) (Hfam x Hx2)). }
  1: { (* GEq_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 fam IHfam Hdom IHdom c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_abs_inv Hy) as [L2 [A3 [b3 [Heq [Hfam Hc]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Abs with (L := L \u L2).
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
         exact (IHfam x Hx1 (open_tm_wrt_tm b3 (a_Var_f x)) (Hfam x Hx2)).
       - apply (IHdom A3 Hc). }
  1: { (* GEq_App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 g IHg cpar IHcpar c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_app_inv Hy) as [g' [b' [Heq [Hpar Hcpar]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_App.
       - apply (IHg g' Hpar).
       - apply (IHcpar b' Hcpar). }
  1: { (* GEq_WSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 g IHg fam IHfam c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_wsigma_inv Hy) as [L2 [A3 [B3 [Heq [Hpar Hfam]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_WSigma with (L := L \u L2).
       - apply (IHg A3 Hpar).
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
         exact (IHfam x Hx1 (open_tm_wrt_tm B3 (a_Var_f x)) (Hfam x Hx2)). }
  1: { (* GEq_WPair *) intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 cpar IHcpar g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_wpair_inv Hy) as [a3 [b3 [Heq [Hc2 Hg2]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_WPair.
       - apply (IHcpar a3 Hc2).
       - apply (IHg b3 Hg2). }
  1: { (* GEq_LetPair *) intros L P psi psi0 a1 b1 a2 b2 g IHg fam IHfam c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_letpair_inv Hy) as [L2 [a3 [b3 [Heq [Hpar Hfam]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_LetPair with (L := L \u L2).
       - apply (IHg a3 Hpar).
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
         exact (IHfam x Hx1 (open_tm_wrt_tm b3 (a_Var_f x)) (Hfam x Hx2)). }
  1: { (* GEq_SSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 g IHg fam IHfam c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_ssigma_inv Hy) as [L2 [A3 [B3 [Heq [Hpar Hfam]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_SSigma with (L := L \u L2).
       - apply (IHg A3 Hpar).
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
         exact (IHfam x Hx1 (open_tm_wrt_tm B3 (a_Var_f x)) (Hfam x Hx2)). }
  1: { (* GEq_SPair *) intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 cpar IHcpar g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_spair_inv Hy) as [a3 [b3 [Heq [Hc2 Hg2]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_SPair.
       - apply (IHcpar a3 Hc2).
       - apply (IHg b3 Hg2). }
  1: { (* GEq_Proj1 *) intros P psi psi0 a1 a2 g IHg i c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_proj1_inv Hy) as [a3 [Heq Hpar]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Proj1.
       - apply (IHg a3 Hpar).
       - exact i. }
  1: { (* GEq_Proj2 *) intros P psi psi0 a1 a2 g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_proj2_inv Hy) as [a3 [Heq Hpar]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Proj2.
       apply (IHg a3 Hpar). }
  1: { (* GEq_Sum *) intros P psi A1 A2 A1' A2' g IHg g0 IHg0 c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_sum_inv Hy) as [A3 [B3 [Heq [Hpar Hpar2]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Sum.
       - apply (IHg A3 Hpar).
       - apply (IHg0 B3 Hpar2). }
  1: { (* GEq_Inj1 *) intros P psi a1 a1' g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_inj1_inv Hy) as [a2 [Heq Hpar]].
       rewrite Heq. apply GEq_Inj1. apply (IHg a2 Hpar). }
  1: { (* GEq_Inj2 *) intros P psi a2 a2' g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_inj2_inv Hy) as [a3 [Heq Hpar]].
       rewrite Heq. apply GEq_Inj2. apply (IHg a3 Hpar). }
  1: { (* GEq_Case *) intros P psi psi0 a b1 b2 a' b1' b2' g IHg g0 IHg0 g1 IHg1 i c Hy.
       destruct (GEq_case_inv Hy) as [a3 [c1 [c2 [Heq [Hpa [Hpb1 Hpb2]]]]]].
       rewrite Heq. eapply GEq_Case.
       - apply (IHg a3 Hpa).
       - apply (IHg0 c1 Hpb1).
       - apply (IHg1 c2 Hpb2).
       - exact i. }
  1: { (* GEq_TyUnit *) intros P psi u c Hy.
       rewrite (GEq_tyunit_inv Hy). eapply GEq_TyUnit; eassumption. }
  1: { (* GEq_TmUnit *) intros P psi u c Hy.
       rewrite (GEq_tmunit_inv Hy). eapply GEq_TmUnit; eassumption. }
  1: { (* CEq_Leq *) intros P psi phi0 a1 a2 i g IHg c Hy.
       destruct (CEq_cases Hy) as [Hl|Hr].
       - destruct Hl as [j Hgeq]. eapply CEq_Leq; [ exact i | apply (IHg c Hgeq) ].
       - destruct Hr as [n _]. exfalso. apply n. exact i. }
  1: { (* CEq_Nleq *) intros P psi phi0 a1 a2 l1 l2 n u c Hy.
       destruct (CEq_cases Hy) as [Hl|Hr].
       - destruct Hl as [j _]. exfalso. apply n. exact j.
       - destruct Hr as [n2 Hrest]. destruct Hrest as [la2 Hrest2].
         destruct Hrest2 as [lb2 Hu].
         eapply CEq_Nleq; [ exact l1 | exact lb2 | exact n | exact u ]. }
  exact H.

- Par diamond, MultiPar confluence (`MultiPar_join`), `Joins_sym`.

- subst_ctx algebra: `subst_ctx_app`, `labels_subst_ctx`, `uniq_subst_ctx`, `meet_ctx_subst_ctx`, etc.

2. Prove full `Typing_subst_mid` with `subst_ctx` (argument typed at binder grade in substituted context; use Typing_grade_mono for T_Var occurrences and Typing_meet_ctx for T_Conv's meet premise).

4. Progress under nil: canonical forms needed only for T_Abs? Actually T_App/T_Proj/T_Case/LetPair require canonical values; may need `DefEq -> Consistent` and Value inversion, or show those rules' premises force a value shape.

T_App/Proj/Case/LetPair require canonical forms: a Value typed at Pi is an Abs; a Value typed at SSigma/WSigma is SPair/WPair; a Value typed at Sum is Inj1/Inj2. These likely follow from DefEq -> Consistent/Joins (agent B) plus inversion of the non-conv typing rule of the value.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Definition grade : Set := grade.

Definition sort : Set := sort.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm)
 | a_WSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_WPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_LetPair (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm).

Definition econtext : Set := list ( atom * grade ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.

Lemma DefEq_grade : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), DefEq P psi a b ->
  Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (DefEq_reg_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:DefEq P psi a b) => Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) => CGrade P psi phi0 a /\ CGrade P psi phi0 b)).
  1: { (* Eq_Refl *) intros P psi a g. split; exact g. }
  1: { (* Eq_Trans *) intros P psi a c b d IHd d0 IHd0.
       destruct IHd as [Ga Gb]. destruct IHd0 as [Gb' Gc]. split; assumption. }
  1: { (* Eq_Sym *) intros P psi b a d IHd. destruct IHd as [Ga Gb]. split; assumption. }
  1: { (* Eq_Beta *) intros P psi a b ga st gb. split; assumption. }
  1: { (* Eq_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd d0 IHfam.
       destruct IHd as [HA1 HA2]. split.
       - eapply G_Pi. exact HA1.
         intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [HB1 HB2]. exact HB1.
       - eapply G_Pi. exact HA2.
         intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [HB1 HB2]. exact HB2. }
  1: { (* Eq_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 c IHc d0 IHfam.
       destruct IHc as [CA1 CA2]. split.
       - eapply G_Abs.
         + intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb1.
         + exact CA1.
       - eapply G_Abs.
         + intros x n. destruct (IHfam x n) as [Hb1 Hb2]. exact Hb2.
         + exact CA2. }
  1: { (* Eq_App *) intros P psi b1 psi0 a1 b2 a2 d IHd c IHc.
       destruct IHd as [Gb1 Gb2]. destruct IHc as [Ca1 Ca2]. split.
       - eapply G_App; [ exact Gb1 | exact Ca1 ].

# 127 — Dependent Dependency Calculus: type safety

## Task

Show that reduction preserves typing and that a closed well-typed term can step or is a value in the dependent dependency calculus.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `Typing_preservation`
- `Typing_progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
Require Import Qual.typing.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Theorem Typing_preservation :
  forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> Ctx W ->
  forall b, Step a b -> Typing W psi b A.

Theorem Typing_progress :
  forall psi a A, Typing nil psi a A -> (exists a', Step a a') \/ Value a.
Qed.

End CanonFromHead.

Definition DefEq_VT_head_spec : Prop :=
  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
    DefEq P psi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b ->
    ctag a = ctag b /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_Pi p A B -> b = a_Pi q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_WSigma p A B -> b = a_WSigma q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_SSigma p A B -> b = a_SSigma q A' B' -> p = q).

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Canonical forms, conditional on DefEq_VT_head_spec.                   *)
(* These are the exact requested conclusions, with the single missing   *)
(* head-invariance principle for DefEq between ValueType terms as an    *)
(* explicit premise.                                                     *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma canon_pi_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
    exists A' b, v = a_Abs psi0 A' b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj1 H) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_wsigma_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
    exists a b, v = a_WPair a psi0 b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_WSigma psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj1 H)) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_ssigma_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) psi0 A B,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
    exists a b, v = a_SPair a psi0 b.
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_SSigma psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj1 H))) psi0 A B). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma canon_sum_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->
  forall psi (v:tm) A1 A2,
    Value v -> Typing nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
    (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a).
Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v A1 A2 Hv Ht.
  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_Sum A1 A2) Hv Ht) as H.
  apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj1 H))) A1 A2). reflexivity.
Qed.

---
name: ddc-typesafety-progress
description: Status and architecture of the Rocq type-safety proof for benchmark 127 (Dependent Dependency Calculus)
metadata:
  type: project
---

Task: prove `Typing_preservation` and `Typing_progress` in `/workspace/Task.v` (Rocq 9.1, support defs in Qualitative_ott.v). Scratch development lives in `/workspace/Dev.v` (NOT submitted; must be ported to Task.v). Dev.v is ~8300 lines, compiled clean, ~330 Qed lemmas, no admits/axioms.

Key proven infrastructure in Dev.v:
- lc/open/subst algebra, Grade/CGrade/Par/CPar metatheory, Grade/Par renaming, weakening, context swap.
- Par diamond, MultiPar confluence (`MultiPar_join`), `Joins_sym`.
- GEq transitivity; GEq head inversions; CEq cases.
- Grade/CGrade/DefEq relabelling (`grade_rel`, `Grade_relabel_mut`, `DefEq_relabel_mut`, `CGrade_relabel`).
- Typing basics: `Typing_lc`, `Typing_uniq`, `Typing_le_C`, `Typing_meet_rel`/`Typing_meet_ctx` (meeting all context grades with q_C), `Typing_raise_rel`/`Typing_grade_mono` (ambient grade raising via inductive `Rctx`), `Rctx` algebra.
- `Step_subst`; `DefEq_subst_mid` (mutual with CDefEq) **but it requires `Grade u` at the ambient context**.
- Grade context helpers: `grade_rel_cons_same`, `grade_rel_cons_both`, `Grade_binder_irrel_mut` (changes a binder grade when the variable is NOT free in the term).
- subst_ctx algebra: `subst_ctx_app`, `labels_subst_ctx`, `uniq_subst_ctx`, `meet_ctx_subst_ctx`, etc.

Crucial unresolved issue: `Typing_subst_mid` needs a standard dependent substitution lemma with `subst_ctx` (substitution in context types), and its T_Conv case invokes `DefEq_subst_mid`, which needs `Grade (labels(meet q_C (subst_ctx u x (C++Q)))) q_C u`. `Typing_grade_meet` (Typing implies Grade at labels(meet q_C W) q_C) is unproven and tricky for T_Abs with annotation psi0 > q_C: Grade's G_Abs family binder is psi0, while the source derivation uses a met binder. Occasional high-binder occurrences are expected only in CGrade_Nleq positions (ignored by Grade), but formalising this needs a “Safe occurrence” predicate or a specialized relabel lemma. `Grade_binder_irrel_mut` is too strong because it requires full absence from fv.

Next steps for a future session:
1. Either prove a safety predicate/relabel allowing Grade under a changed high binder for terms whose occurrences are only under CGrade_Nleq, or find another way to discharge Grade of the beta argument.
2. Prove full `Typing_subst_mid` with `subst_ctx` (argument typed at binder grade in substituted context; use Typing_grade_mono for T_Var occurrences and Typing_meet_ctx for T_Conv's meet premise).
3. Prove preservation by induction on Typing (T_Conv via IH; beta via substitution lemma; all congruence rules direct).
4. Progress under nil: canonical forms needed only for T_Abs? Actually T_App/T_Proj/T_Case/LetPair require canonical values; may need `DefEq -> Consistent` and Value inversion, or show those rules' premises force a value shape.
5. Port everything to Task.v and run `make`.

Do not use Admitted/admit/Axiom. Task.v and Task.v.orig are unchanged as of last check.

Preservation/progress case plan (needs agents' outputs):
- Preservation induction on Typing; Ctx W available. T_Conv uses IH on its first premise then re-applies same T_Conv. T_App: S_AppCong via IH on function typing; S_Beta needs an Abs-at-Pi inversion + dependent typing substitution to get Typing W psi (open body arg) (open codomain arg), with conversions between the base Abs Pi type and the syntactic Pi in T_App. T_Case/Proj/LetPair betas need analogous SSigma/WSigma canonical/inversion facts.
- Progress induction on Typing nil. T_Conv via IH. T_App/Proj/Case/LetPair require canonical forms: a Value typed at Pi is an Abs; a Value typed at SSigma/WSigma is SPair/WPair; a Value typed at Sum is Inj1/Inj2. These likely follow from DefEq -> Consistent/Joins (agent B) plus inversion of the non-conv typing rule of the value.
- Two background workers were launched: one on Typing_grade_meet/substitution in /tmp/agentdev/Dev.v, one on GEq/Par simulation, Joins transitivity/congruence, DefEq -> Joins/Consistent and canonical-value corollaries in /tmp/joindev/Dev.v. Their code must be merged into /workspace/Dev.v (or Task.v) only after verifying it compiles and contains no escapes.

Progress proof validated in /tmp/progress_skeleton.v: `Typing_progress_skeleton` compiles with dependent induction on Typing and four Section variables:
canon_pi, canon_wsigma, canon_ssigma, canon_sum (statements in the file). It shows the whole induction is structurally correct; only these canonical-form lemmas are missing. Agent B was asked to prove them after DefEq->Consistent.
