(* ---------------- relabelling grades of an econtext ---------------- *)

Definition grade_rel (psi:grade) (P P':econtext) : Prop :=
  dom P [=] dom P' /\
  uniq P /\ uniq P' /\
  (forall x g g', binds x g P -> binds x g' P' ->
     g = g' \/ (g <= psi /\ g' <= psi)).

Lemma grade_rel_cons_same : forall psi (P P':econtext) x g,
  grade_rel psi P P' -> x `notin` dom P -> x `notin` dom P' ->
  grade_rel psi ((x,g)::P) ((x,g)::P').
Proof.
  intros psi P P' x g Hr Hx Hx'. destruct Hr as [Hdom [Hu [Hu' Hrel]]].
  split.
  - simpl. rewrite Hdom. reflexivity.
  - split.
    + apply uniq_cons; [ exact Hu | exact Hx ].
    + split.
      * apply uniq_cons; [ exact Hu' | exact Hx' ].
      * intros y g1 g2 Hb1 Hb2. simpl in Hb1, Hb2.
        destruct Hb1 as [Heq1|Hin1]; destruct Hb2 as [Heq2|Hin2].
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hg1 : g1 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hy2 : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq2)).
           assert (Hg2 : g2 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq2)).
           subst y. subst g1. subst g2. left. reflexivity.
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hg1 : g1 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq1)).
           subst y. subst g1. exfalso.
           assert (Hin : x `in` dom P').
           { exact (@In_dom_mem P' x g2 Hin2). }
           exact (Hx' Hin).
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq2)).
           assert (Hg2 : g2 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq2)).
           subst y. subst g2. exfalso.
           assert (Hin : x `in` dom P).
           { exact (@In_dom_mem P x g1 Hin1). }
           exact (Hx Hin).
        -- exact (Hrel y g1 g2 Hin1 Hin2).
Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_dom : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> dom P [=] dom P'.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 H). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_uniq : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> uniq P.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 (proj2 H)). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_uniq' : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> uniq P'.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 H))). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_binds : forall psi (P P':econtext) x g g',
  grade_rel psi P P' -> binds x g P -> binds x g' P' ->
  g = g' \/ (g <= psi /\ g' <= psi).
Proof. intros psi P P' x g g' H. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 H)) x g g'). Qed.
Lemma Grade_relabel_mut : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> Grade P' psi a.
Proof.
  intros P0 PSI0 a0 H.
  apply (Grade_mut
    (fun P psi a (_:Grade P psi a) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> Grade P' psi a)
    (fun P psi phi0 a (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> CGrade P' psi phi0 a)).
  1: { (* G_Type *) intros P psi s Hu P' Hr. apply G_Type. exact (grade_rel_uniq' Hr). }
  1: { (* G_Var *) intros P psi x gv Hu Hle Hb P' Hr.
       assert (Hxin : x `in` dom P) by (eapply In_dom_mem; exact Hb).
       assert (Hxin' : x `in` dom P').
       { rewrite <- (grade_rel_dom Hr). exact Hxin. }
       destruct (@binds_In_inv grade x P' Hxin') as [g' Hb'].
       eapply G_Var with (psi0 := g').
       - exact (grade_rel_uniq' Hr).
       - destruct (@grade_rel_binds psi P P' x gv g' Hr Hb Hb') as [Heq|[_ Hg']].
         + subst g'. exact Hle.
         + exact Hg'.
       - exact Hb'. }
  1: { (* G_Pi *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg fam IHfam P' Hr.
       eapply G_Pi with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHg; exact Hr.
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxdom].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxdom. destruct Hxdom as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHfam x HxL ((x,psi)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP']. }
  1: { (* G_Abs *) intros L P psi psi0 A b fam IHfam c IHc P' Hr.
       eapply G_Abs with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxdom].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxdom. destruct Hxdom as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHfam x HxL ((x,psi0)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP'].
       - apply IHc; exact Hr. }
  1: { (* G_App *) intros P psi b psi0 a g IHg c IHc P' Hr.
       eapply G_App; [apply IHg; exact Hr | apply IHc; exact Hr]. }
  1: { (* G_WSigma *) intros L P psi psi0 A B g IHg fam IHfam P' Hr.
       eapply G_WSigma with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHg; exact Hr.
       - intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxdom].
         apply notin_union_inv in Hxdom. destruct Hxdom as [HxP HxP'].
         apply (IHfam x HxL ((x,psi)::P')).
         apply grade_rel_cons_same; [exact Hr | exact HxP | exact HxP']. }
  1: { (* G_WPair *) intros P psi a psi0 b c IHc g IHg P' Hr.
       eapply G_WPair; [apply IHc; exact Hr | apply IHg; exact Hr]. }
  1: { (* G_LetPair *) intros L P psi psi0 a c g IHg fam IHfam P' Hr.
       eapply G_LetPair with (L := L \u dom P \u dom P').
       - apply IHg; exact Hr.

Lemma GEq_grade : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (GEq_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:GEq P psi a b) => Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) => CGrade P psi phi0 a /\ CGrade P psi phi0 b)).
  all: try split.
  all: reg_atom.
  Unshelve. all: fail 1 "OPEN GEq_grade".
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall t j z,
  lc_at j (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec j (a_Var_f z) t) <-> lc_at (S j) t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; simpl; intros j z; try tauto.
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; split; intros; lia.
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - split.
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt3 j z) H3).
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt3 j z) H3).
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - exact (IHt j z).
Qed.

Fixpoint size_tm (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (size_tm A + size_tm b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => S (size_tm A1 + size_tm A2)
  | a_Inj1 a => S (size_tm a)
  | a_Inj2 a => S (size_tm a)
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => S (size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2)
  | a_WSigma _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_WPair a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_LetPair _ a b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => S (size_tm a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => S (size_tm a)
  end.

Lemma size_tm_open_rec : forall t k z,
  size_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) t) = size_tm t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; simpl; intros k z; auto;
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 k z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 (S k) z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt k z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 k z), (IHt3 k z); auto).
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma size_tm_open : forall t z,
  size_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm t (a_Var_f z)) = size_tm t.
Proof. intros; apply size_tm_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_lc_at_1 : forall t, lc_tm t -> lc_at 0 t.
Proof.
  intros t H. induction H; simpl;
  try (repeat split; assumption);
  try (split; [ assumption | ]).
  all: try match goal with
           | Hx : forall x, lc_at 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm ?B (a_Var_f x)) |- lc_at 1 ?B =>
               pose proof (Hx (Atom.fresh nil)) as Hz; rewrite lc_at_open in Hz; exact Hz
           end.
  all: auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_lc_tm_1 : forall n t, (size_tm t <= n)%nat -> lc_at 0 t -> lc_tm t.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros t Hle Hla.

  - destruct t; simpl in Hla; simpl in Hle.

    + constructor.

      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm t2 (a_Var_f x))).

      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm t2 (a_Var_f x))).
        -- rewrite size_tm_open; lia.
        -- rewrite lc_at_open; exact H2.
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * apply (IH t2); [ lia | exact H2 ].
    + constructor.
    + lia.
    + constructor.
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * apply (IH t2); [ lia | exact H2 ].
    + constructor. apply (IH t0); [ lia | exact Hla ].
    + constructor. apply (IH t0); [ lia | exact Hla ].
    + destruct Hla as [H1 [H2 H3]]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * apply (IH t2); [ lia | exact H2 ].
      * apply (IH t3); [ lia | exact H3 ].
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm t2 (a_Var_f x))).
        -- rewrite size_tm_open; lia.
        -- rewrite lc_at_open; exact H2.
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * apply (IH t2); [ lia | exact H2 ].
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm t2 (a_Var_f x))).
        -- rewrite size_tm_open; lia.
        -- rewrite lc_at_open; exact H2.
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * intro x. apply (IH (open_tm_wrt_tm t2 (a_Var_f x))).
        -- rewrite size_tm_open; lia.
        -- rewrite lc_at_open; exact H2.
    + destruct Hla as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH t1); [ lia | exact H1 ].
      * apply (IH t2); [ lia | exact H2 ].
    + constructor. apply (IH t0); [ lia | exact Hla ].
    + constructor. apply (IH t0); [ lia | exact Hla ].
Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_lc_at : forall t, lc_tm t <-> lc_at 0 t.
Proof.
  intros t. split; intros H.
  - apply lc_tm_lc_at_1; exact H.
  - exact (@lc_at_lc_tm_1 (size_tm t) t (Nat.le_refl _) H).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_all : forall (L:atoms) b,
  (forall x, x \notin L -> lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  forall x, lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros L b H x.
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [z Hz].
  assert (Hz' : lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z))) by (apply H; exact Hz).
  assert (H1 : lc_at 1 b).
  { apply (proj1 (lc_at_open b z)).
    apply (proj1 (@lc_tm_lc_at (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f z)))). exact Hz'. }
  apply (proj2 (@lc_tm_lc_at (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)))).
  apply (proj2 (lc_at_open b x)). exact H1.
Qed.

(* Grade implies locally closed. *)
Lemma Grade_lc : forall (P:econtext) psi (t0:tm), Grade P psi t0 -> lc_tm t0.
Proof.
  intros P psi t0 H.
  refine (Grade_mut (fun P psi a d => lc_tm a)
                    (fun P psi phi0 a d => lc_tm a)
          _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H).
  - (* G_Type *) intros. apply lc_a_Type.
  - (* G_Var *) intros. apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - (* G_Pi *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_Abs *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A b g IH c IHc.
    apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact IHc.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH. exact Hx.
  - (* G_App *) intros. apply lc_a_App; assumption.
  - (* G_WSigma *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_WSigma.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_WPair *) intros. apply lc_a_WPair; assumption.
  - (* G_LetPair *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 a c g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_LetPair.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_SSigma *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_SPair *) intros. apply lc_a_SPair; assumption.
  - (* G_Proj1 *) intros. apply lc_a_Proj1; assumption.
  - (* G_Proj2 *) intros. apply lc_a_Proj2; assumption.
  - (* G_Sum *) intros. apply lc_a_Sum; assumption.
  - (* G_Inj1 *) intros. apply lc_a_Inj1; assumption.
  - (* G_Inj2 *) intros. apply lc_a_Inj2; assumption.
  - (* G_Case *) intros. eapply lc_a_Case; eassumption.
  - (* G_TyUnit *) intros. apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - (* G_TmUnit *) intros. apply lc_a_TmUnit.
  - (* CG_Leq *) intros P1 phi phi0 a Hle g IH. exact IH.
  - (* CG_Nleq *) intros. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_le : forall (t:tm) k k', (k <= k')%nat -> lc_at k t -> lc_at k' t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; intros k k' Hle H; simpl in *.
  - exact I. - exact I.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHt1 k k'); auto.
    + apply (IHt2 (S k) (S k')); [ lia | exact H2 ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHt1 k k'); auto.
    + apply (IHt2 (S k) (S k')); [ lia | exact H2 ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply (IHt1 k k'); auto | apply (IHt2 k k'); auto ].
  - exact I.
  - lia.
  - exact I.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply (IHt1 k k'); auto | apply (IHt2 k k'); auto ].
  - apply (IHt k k'); auto.
  - apply (IHt k k'); auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; [ apply (IHt1 k k'); auto | apply (IHt2 k k'); auto | apply (IHt3 k k'); auto ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHt1 k k'); auto.
    + apply (IHt2 (S k) (S k')); [ lia | exact H2 ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply (IHt1 k k'); auto | apply (IHt2 k k'); auto ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHt1 k k'); auto.
    + apply (IHt2 (S k) (S k')); [ lia | exact H2 ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply (IHt1 k k'); auto.
    + apply (IHt2 (S k) (S k')); [ lia | exact H2 ].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply (IHt1 k k'); auto | apply (IHt2 k k'); auto ].
  - apply (IHt k k'); auto.
  - apply (IHt k k'); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_open_term : forall (b u:tm) k,
  lc_at (S k) b -> lc_at k u -> lc_at k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u b).
Proof.
  intros b. induction b; intros u k Hb Hu; simpl in *.
  - exact I. - exact I.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHb1; assumption.
    + apply IHb2; [ | apply lc_at_le with (k:=k); [ lia | exact Hu ] ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHb1; assumption.
    + apply IHb2; [ | apply lc_at_le with (k:=k); [ lia | exact Hu ] ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply IHb1; assumption | apply IHb2; assumption ].
  - exact I.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl.
    + exact H.
    + subst n. exact Hu.
    + lia.
  - exact I.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply IHb1; assumption | apply IHb2; assumption ].
  - apply IHb; assumption.
  - apply IHb; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split]; [ apply IHb1 | apply IHb2 | apply IHb3 ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHb1; assumption.
    + apply IHb2; [ | apply lc_at_le with (k:=k); [ lia | exact Hu ] ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply IHb1; assumption | apply IHb2; assumption ].
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHb1; assumption.
    + apply IHb2; [ | apply lc_at_le with (k:=k); [ lia | exact Hu ] ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHb1; assumption.
    + apply IHb2; [ | apply lc_at_le with (k:=k); [ lia | exact Hu ] ]; assumption.
  - destruct Hb as [H1 H2]. split; [ apply IHb1; assumption | apply IHb2; assumption ].
  - apply IHb; assumption.
  - apply IHb; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_1_of_open : forall (b:tm),
  (forall x, lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) -> lc_at 1 b.

  apply (proj1 (lc_at_open b (Atom.fresh nil))).

  intros P psi t u H.

Require Import Qual.typing.
From Stdlib Require Import Classical.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------------- locally closed characterization ---------------- *)

Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs psi A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Type s => True
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => lc_at k A1 /\ lc_at k A2
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a

Lemma Par_open : forall (P:econtext) psi g (b1 b2:tm) (L:atoms) (u v:tm),
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  CPar P psi g u v ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 v).
Proof.
  intros P psi g b1 b2 L u v Hfam Hcp.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) as [x Hx].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxrest].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hxrest. destruct Hxrest as [Hxfv1 Hxfv2].
  assert (HP : Par ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))).
  { apply Hfam; exact HxL. }
  pose (Hres := @Par_subst_var ((x,g)::P) psi
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)) HP
                 nil P x g u v Logic.eq_refl Hcp).
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b1 x u Hxfv1) in Hres.
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b2 x v Hxfv2) in Hres.

(* ---------------- opening undoes closing ---------------- *)

Lemma close_var_b_lt : forall (m n:nat) (x:atom), (m < n)%nat ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b m.
Proof.
  intros m n x H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge]; [reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

Lemma close_var_b_ge : forall (m n:nat) (x:atom), (n <= m)%nat ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b (S m).
Proof.
  intros m n x H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge]; [lia|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma close_var_f_eq : forall (x y:atom) n, x = y ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  intros x y n H. subst y. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  match goal with |- context[if ?d then ?a else ?b] => destruct d as [e|ne] end.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma close_var_f_neq : forall (x y:atom) n, x <> y ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof.
  intros x y n H. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  match goal with |- context[if ?d then ?a else ?b] => destruct d as [e|ne] end.
  - exfalso; apply H; exact e.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_lt : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), (m < n)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b m.
Proof.
  intros m n u H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m n) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [reflexivity|lia|lia].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_eq : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), m = n ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = u.
Proof.
  intros m n u H. subst n. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m m) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [lia|reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_gt : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), (n < m)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b (m - 1).
Proof.
  intros m n u H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m n) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [lia|lia|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_f : forall (x y:atom) (u:tm) n,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

    [ | | psi A B HlA IHA HlB IHB | psi A b HlA IHA Hlb IHb
    | a0 psi b Hla IHa Hlb IHb | s | x0
    | A1 A2 Hl1 IH1 Hl2 IH2 | a0 Hla IHa | a0 Hla IHa
    | psi a0 b1 b2 Hla IHa Hlb1 IHb1 Hlb2 IHb2
    | psi A B HlA IHA HlB IHB | a0 psi b Hla IHa Hlb IHb
    | psi a0 b Hla IHa Hlb IHb
    | psi A B HlA IHA HlB IHB | a0 psi b Hla IHa Hlb IHb
    | psi a0 Hla IHa | psi a0 Hla IHa ];
    intros P phi0 Hu Hws.
  - split.
    + apply G_TyUnit. exact Hu.
    + eapply CG_Leq; [ apply le_qTop | apply G_TyUnit; exact Hu ].
  - split.
    + apply G_TmUnit. exact Hu.
    + eapply CG_Leq; [ apply le_qTop | apply G_TmUnit; exact Hu ].

    assert (GB : forall y, y `notin` dom P -> Grade ((y,q_Top)::P) q_Top (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y))).

        - simpl in Hz. apply singleton_iff in Hz. subst z. apply ws_dom_cons. }
      exact (proj1 (IHB y ((y,q_Top)::P) q_Top Huy Hwsy)). }
    assert (GP : Grade P q_Top (a_Pi psi A B)).
    { apply (G_Pi (dom P)). exact GA. exact GB. }
    split; [ exact GP | eapply CG_Leq; [ apply le_qTop | exact GP ] ].
  - assert (CA : CGrade P q_Top q_Top A).

Lemma Grade_lc_top : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext),
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) -> Grade P q_Top a.
Proof.
  intros a P Hlc Hu Hws.
  exact (proj1 (@Grade_lc_top_aux a Hlc P q_Top Hu Hws)).
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_lc_top : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext) phi0,
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) -> CGrade P q_Top phi0 a.
Proof.
  intros a P phi0 Hlc Hu Hws.
  exact (proj2 (@Grade_lc_top_aux a Hlc P phi0 Hu Hws)).
Qed.

(* At annotation q_Top (the irrelevant grade), any well-scoped lc term is
   CGrade at any ambient grade. *)
Lemma CGrade_top_any : forall (a:tm) (P:econtext) phi,
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (forall y, y `in` fv_tm_tm a -> y `in` dom P) ->
  CGrade P phi q_Top a.
Proof.
  intros a P phi Hlc Hu Hws.
  destruct (classic (q_Top <= phi)) as [Hle|Hnle].
  - (* phi = q_Top *)
    assert (Hphi : phi = q_Top) by (apply qTop_le_eq; exact Hle).

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
Lemma Par_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.

Definition DefEq_VT_head_spec : Prop :=
  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
    DefEq P psi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b ->
    ctag a = ctag b /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_Pi p A B -> b = a_Pi q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_WSigma p A B -> b = a_WSigma q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_SSigma p A B -> b = a_SSigma q A' B' -> p = q).

Lemma canon_pi_from_head :
  DefEq_VT_head_spec ->

Proof.
  intros Hhead psi v psi0 A B Hv Ht.

  apply (proj1 (proj1 H) psi0 A B). reflexivity.

Proof.

Lemma open_close_subst_gen : forall (E:tm) n z x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n z E)
  = subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros n z x.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHB (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHb (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_lt m n z Hlt). rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m n (a_Var_f x) Hlt).
      simpl. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_ge m n z Hge).

Lemma Par_dia_pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2,
  Par P psi A1 A2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi A1 c -> exists d, Par P psi A2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> forall c,
      Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) c ->
      exists d, Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) d /\
                Par ((x,psi)::P) psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd fam IHfam c H2.
  destruct (Par_pi_inv H2) as [L2 [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].
    set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm B2 \u fv_tm_tm B1' \u dom P).
    destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz].
    unfold Ltot in Hz.
    apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [HzB2 Hzr3].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr3. destruct Hzr3 as [HzB1' Hzdom].
    destruct (IHfam z HzL (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) (Hpb z HzL2))
      as [dz [HdzB2 HdzB1']].
    pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
    assert (Hfam2 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
      pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB2
                    nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B2 z x HzB2) in Hren.
      rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
      unfold body. exact Hren. }
    assert (Hfam1 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
      pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB1'
                    nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B1' z x HzB1') in Hren.
      rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
      unfold body. exact Hren. }
    exists (a_Pi psi1 dA body). split.
    + eapply Par_Pi with (L := Ltot).
      * exact HA2.
      * exact Hfam2.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Pi with (L := Ltot).
      * exact HA1'.
      * exact Hfam1.
Qed.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros PP ps0 a0 b0 H.
  apply (Par_mut
    (fun P psi a b (_:Par P psi a b) =>
       forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d)
    (fun P psi phi0 a b (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
       forall c, CPar P psi phi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi phi0 b d /\ CPar P psi phi0 c d)).

    [ exact Par_dia_refl

    | exact Par_dia_casebeta1
    | exact Par_dia_casebeta2
    | exact Par_dia_case

  exact H.

(* Canonical forms for value typings.                                   *)
(* The only missing ingredient is label/head invariance of DefEq        *)

Lemma lc_tm_WSigma_fst : forall p A B, lc_tm (a_WSigma p A B) -> lc_tm A.
Proof. intros p A B H; inversion H; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_SSigma_fst : forall p A B, lc_tm (a_SSigma p A B) -> lc_tm A.
Proof. intros p A B H; inversion H; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_Sum_fst : forall A B, lc_tm (a_Sum A B) -> lc_tm A.
Proof. intros A B H; inversion H; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_Sum_snd : forall A B, lc_tm (a_Sum A B) -> lc_tm B.
Proof. intros A B H; inversion H; assumption. Qed.

Lemma ValueType_of_Pi_lc : forall p A B,
  lc_tm (a_Pi p A B) -> ValueType (a_Pi p A B).
Proof.
  intros p A B H. apply ValueType_Pi.
  - apply lc_tm_Pi_fst in H. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma ValueType_of_WSigma_lc : forall p A B,
  lc_tm (a_WSigma p A B) -> ValueType (a_WSigma p A B).
Proof.
  intros p A B H. apply ValueType_WSigma.
  - apply lc_tm_WSigma_fst in H. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma ValueType_of_SSigma_lc : forall p A B,
  lc_tm (a_SSigma p A B) -> ValueType (a_SSigma p A B).
Proof.
  intros p A B H. apply ValueType_SSigma.
  - apply lc_tm_SSigma_fst in H. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma ValueType_of_Sum_lc : forall A B,
  lc_tm (a_Sum A B) -> ValueType (a_Sum A B).
Proof.
  intros A B H. apply ValueType_Sum.
  - apply lc_tm_Sum_fst in H. exact H.
  - pose proof (lc_tm_Sum_snd (A:=A) (B:=B) H) as Hs. exact Hs.
Qed.

Ltac val_absurd :=
  match goal with
  | Hv : Value ?t |- _ =>
      inversion Hv; subst;
      try (match goal with H3 : ValueType _ |- _ => inversion H3 end)
  end.

Ltac lc_from_typing :=
  match goal with
  | H : Typing ?W ?psi ?C ?A |- lc_tm ?C => exact (@Typing_lc W psi C A H)
  end.

Lemma Typing_value_lc_type : forall (W:context) psi (v C:tm),
  Value v -> Typing W psi v C -> lc_tm C.
Proof.
  intros W psi v C Hv Ht.
  revert Hv.
  induction Ht; intros Hv.
  - (* T_Type *) constructor.
  - (* T_Conv *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_Var *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_Pi *) constructor.
  - (* T_Abs *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_App *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_AppIrrel *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_WSigma *) constructor.
  - (* T_WPair *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_WPairIrrel *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_LetPair *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_SSigma *) constructor.
  - (* T_SPair *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_Proj1 *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_Proj2 *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_Sum *) constructor.
  - (* T_Inj1 *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_Inj2 *) lc_from_typing.
  - (* T_Case *) val_absurd.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) constructor.
  - (* T_TyUnit *) constructor.
Qed.

Definition CanonSpec (v C:tm) : Prop :=
  (forall p X Y, C = a_Pi p X Y -> exists A' b, v = a_Abs p A' b) /\
  (forall p X Y, C = a_WSigma p X Y -> exists a b, v = a_WPair a p b) /\
  (forall p X Y, C = a_SSigma p X Y -> exists a b, v = a_SPair a p b) /\
  (forall X Y, C = a_Sum X Y ->
     (exists a, v = a_Inj1 a) \/ (exists a, v = a_Inj2 a)).

Ltac vacuous_canon :=
  unfold CanonSpec; split; [|split;[|split]];
  [ intros p X Y HC; discriminate HC
  | intros p X Y HC; discriminate HC
  | intros p X Y HC; discriminate HC
  | intros X Y HC; discriminate HC ].

Lemma VT_Pi_of_DefEq : forall (P:econtext) psi (X:tm) p A B,
  DefEq P psi X (a_Pi p A B) -> ValueType (a_Pi p A B).
Proof.
  intros P psi X p A B H. apply ValueType_of_Pi_lc.
  exact (Grade_lc (proj2 (@DefEq_grade P psi X (a_Pi p A B) H))).
Qed.

Lemma VT_WSigma_of_DefEq : forall (P:econtext) psi (X:tm) p A B,
  DefEq P psi X (a_WSigma p A B) -> ValueType (a_WSigma p A B).
Proof.
  intros P psi X p A B H. apply ValueType_of_WSigma_lc.
  exact (Grade_lc (proj2 (@DefEq_grade P psi X (a_WSigma p A B) H))).
Qed.

Lemma VT_SSigma_of_DefEq : forall (P:econtext) psi (X:tm) p A B,
  DefEq P psi X (a_SSigma p A B) -> ValueType (a_SSigma p A B).
Proof.
  intros P psi X p A B H. apply ValueType_of_SSigma_lc.
  exact (Grade_lc (proj2 (@DefEq_grade P psi X (a_SSigma p A B) H))).
Qed.

Lemma VT_Sum_of_DefEq : forall (P:econtext) psi (X:tm) A B,
  DefEq P psi X (a_Sum A B) -> ValueType (a_Sum A B).
Proof.
  intros P psi X A B H. apply ValueType_of_Sum_lc.
  exact (Grade_lc (proj2 (@DefEq_grade P psi X (a_Sum A B) H))).
Qed.

  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),

    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_WSigma p A B -> b = a_WSigma q A' B' -> p = q) /\
    (forall p A B q A' B', a = a_SSigma p A B -> b = a_SSigma q A' B' -> p = q).

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=

 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->

     lc_tm b1 ->

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a

 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),

     Grade P psi b ->

 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.

Lemma le_antisym_g : forall a b, a <= b -> b <= a -> a = b.
Proof.

Qed.

Proof. intro a. apply leq_join. apply join_Top_r. Qed.

Proof.

Lemma Grade_lc : forall (P:econtext) psi (t0:tm), Grade P psi t0 -> lc_tm t0.
Proof.
  intros P psi t0 H.
  refine (Grade_mut (fun P psi a d => lc_tm a)
                    (fun P psi phi0 a d => lc_tm a)
          _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H).

  - (* G_Var *) intros. apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - (* G_Pi *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_Abs *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A b g IH c IHc.
    apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact IHc.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH. exact Hx.
  - (* G_App *) intros. apply lc_a_App; assumption.
  - (* G_WSigma *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    apply lc_a_WSigma.
    + exact IH.
    + eapply lc_open_all. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - (* G_WPair *) intros. apply lc_a_WPair; assumption.
  - (* G_LetPair *) intros L P1 psi1 psi0 a c g IH g0 IH0.

  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d ->
  exists (L:vars) A' B, d = a_Abs psi0 A' B /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
       Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A a d H.
  destruct (Par_abs_inv H) as [L2 [A' [a' [Heq HD]]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA Ha]|[Hcp Hfam]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite Ha in Heq.
    pose proof (Par_grade_r H) as Hg. rewrite Heq in Hg.
    destruct (Grade_abs_fam Hg) as [Lg Hfg].
    exists (L2 \u Lg), A, a. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx2 Hxg].
      apply Par_Refl. apply Hfg. exact Hxg.
  - exists L2, A', a'. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + exact Hfam.
Qed.

Lemma Par_pi_body_family : forall (P:econtext) psi psi1 A B d,
  Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A B) d ->
  exists (L:vars) A' B', d = a_Pi psi1 A' B' /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L ->
       Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi1 A B d H.
  destruct (Par_pi_inv H) as [L2 [A' [B' [Heq HD]]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[HparA Hfam]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    pose proof (Par_grade_r H) as Hg. rewrite Heq in Hg.
    destruct (Grade_pi_fam Hg) as [Lg Hfg].
    exists (L2 \u Lg), A, B. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + intros x Hx. apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx2 Hxg].
      apply Par_Refl. apply Hfg. exact Hxg.
  - exists L2, A', B'. split.
    + exact Heq.
    + exact Hfam.
Qed.

(* ---------------- parallel reduction diamond, per-constructor helpers ---------------- *)

Lemma Par_dia_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi a d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a g c H2. exists c. split.
  - exact H2.
  - apply Par_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H2).
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_sum : forall (P:econtext) psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
  Par P psi A1 A2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi A1 c -> exists d, Par P psi A2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  Par P psi B1 B2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi B1 c -> exists d, Par P psi B2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Sum A1 B1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Sum A2 B2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi A1 B1 A2 B2 dA IHdA dB IHdB c H2.
  destruct (Par_sum_inv H2) as [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_Sum A2 B2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Sum; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Sum; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHdA A1' Hpa) as [d1 [HA2 HA1']].
    destruct (IHdB B1' Hpb) as [d2 [HB2 HB1']].
    exists (a_Sum d1 d2). split.
    + eapply Par_Sum; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Sum; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_inj1 : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 a2,
  Par P psi a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a1 c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Inj1 a1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Inj1 a2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a1 a2 d IHd c H2.
  destruct (Par_inj1_inv H2) as [a' [Heq HD]].
  destruct HD as [Ha'|Hpar].
  - subst a'.
    exists (a_Inj1 a2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Inj1; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Inj1; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd a' Hpar) as [d0 [Ha2 Ha'']].
    exists (a_Inj1 d0). split.
    + eapply Par_Inj1; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Inj1; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_inj2 : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 a2,
  Par P psi a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a1 c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Inj2 a1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Inj2 a2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a1 a2 d IHd c H2.
  destruct (Par_inj2_inv H2) as [a' [Heq HD]].
  destruct HD as [Ha'|Hpar].
  - subst a'.
    exists (a_Inj2 a2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Inj2; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Inj2; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd a' Hpar) as [d0 [Ha2 Ha'']].
    exists (a_Inj2 d0). split.
    + eapply Par_Inj2; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Inj2; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_wpair : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2,
  CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a1 c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 a2 d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d) ->
  Par P psi b1 b2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi b1 c -> exists d, Par P psi b2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 dA IHdA dB IHdB c H2.
  destruct (Par_wpair_inv H2) as [a1' [b1' [Heq HD]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hcpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHdA a1' Hcpa) as [d1 [HA2 HA1']].
    destruct (IHdB b1' Hpb) as [d2 [HB2 HB1']].
    exists (a_WPair d1 psi0 d2). split.
    + eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_WPair; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_spair : forall (P:econtext) psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2,
  CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a1 c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 a2 d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d) ->
  Par P psi b1 b2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi b1 c -> exists d, Par P psi b2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a1 psi0 b1 a2 b2 dA IHdA dB IHdB c H2.
  destruct (Par_spair_inv H2) as [a1' [b1' [Heq HD]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hcpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHdA a1' Hcpa) as [d1 [HA2 HA1']].
    destruct (IHdB b1' Hpb) as [d2 [HB2 HB1']].
    exists (a_SPair d1 psi0 d2). split.
    + eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_SPair; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2,
  Par P psi A1 A2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi A1 c -> exists d, Par P psi A2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> forall c,
      Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) c ->
      exists d, Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) d /\
                Par ((x,psi)::P) psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros L P psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 d IHd fam IHfam c H2.
  destruct (Par_pi_inv H2) as [L2 [A1' [B1' [Heq HD]]]].
  destruct HD as [[HA HB]|[Hpa Hpb]].
  - rewrite HA in Heq. rewrite HB in Heq.
    exists (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
    + rewrite Heq. eapply Par_Pi; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd A1' Hpa) as [dA [HA2 HA1']].
    set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm B2 \u fv_tm_tm B1' \u dom P).
    destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz].
    unfold Ltot in Hz.
    apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr2. destruct Hzr2 as [HzB2 Hzr3].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr3. destruct Hzr3 as [HzB1' Hzdom].
    destruct (IHfam z HzL (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f z)) (Hpb z HzL2))
      as [dz [HdzB2 HdzB1']].
    pose (body := close_tm_wrt_tm z dz).
    assert (Hfam2 : forall x, x `notin` Ltot ->
              Par ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x))).
    { intros x Hx. unfold Ltot in Hx.
      apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxr1].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr1. destruct Hxr1 as [HxL2 Hxr2].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr2. destruct Hxr2 as [HxB2 Hxr3].
      apply notin_union_inv in Hxr3. destruct Hxr3 as [HxB1' Hxdom].
      pose proof (@Par_rename_mid ((z,psi)::P) psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) dz HdzB2
                    nil P z psi x Logic.eq_refl Hxdom) as Hren.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var_fresh B2 z x HzB2) in Hren.
      rewrite <- (@open_close_subst_gen dz 0 z x) in Hren.
      unfold body. exact Hren. }

Lemma Par_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht.
  - exact Ht.
  - eauto using Par_ctag.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_ctag : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall t, ctag a = Some t -> ctag b = Some t.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros t Ht; simpl in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctag_Type : forall s, ctag (a_Type s) = Some TType.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------------- basic Par facts ---------------- *)

Lemma Par_refl_g : forall (P:econtext) psi a, Grade P psi a -> Par P psi a a.
Proof. intros; apply Par_Refl; assumption. Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_refl_g : forall (P:econtext) psi a, Grade P psi a -> MultiPar P psi a a.
Proof. intros; apply MP_Refl; assumption. Qed.

Lemma Step_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros. eapply MP_Step.
  - eapply Step_par; eassumption.
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi a, Grade P psi a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros. eapply join.
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption.

(* ---------------- multi-step parallel reduction: composition and confluence ---------------- *)

Lemma MultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - exact g.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros c H2. exact H2.
  - intros c H2. eapply MP_Step.
    + exact p.
    + apply IH. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Par_multipar : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. eapply MP_Step.
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_strip : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, MultiPar P psi a c -> exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hp c Hmc. revert b Hp.
  induction Hmc as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x c p mc IH].
  - intros b Hp. exists b. split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (Par_grade_r Hp).
    + exact Hp.
  - intros b Hp.
    destruct (Par_diamond Hp p) as [y [Hby Hxy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hmd Hcd]].
    exists d. split.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi a c ->
    exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Hmb. induction Hmb as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 x b0 p mb IH].
  - intros c Hmc. exists c. split.
    + exact Hmc.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (MultiPar_grade_r Hmc).
  - intros c Hmc.
    destruct (Par_strip p Hmc) as [y [Hxy Hcy]].
    destruct (IH y Hxy) as [d [Hbd Hyd]].
    exists d. split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + eapply MP_Step; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b1 b2 mp1 mp2 geq].
  eapply join.
  - exact mp2.
  - exact mp1.
  - apply GEq_sym. exact geq.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Definition grade : Set := grade.

Definition sort : Set := sort.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm)
 | a_WSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_WPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_LetPair (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm).

Definition econtext : Set := list ( atom * grade ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case psi a b1 b2))
 | lc_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_WPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_LetPair : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))

Lemma open_close_rec : forall (t:tm) n x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x t) = t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros n x.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHb (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_lt m n x Hlt). rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m n (a_Var_f x) Hlt). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_ge m n x Hge).
      assert (HnSm : (n < S m)%nat) by lia.
      rewrite (@open_var_b_gt (S m) n (a_Var_f x) HnSm).
      replace (S m - 1) with m by lia. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (x = y)) as [Heq|Hne].
    + rewrite (@close_var_f_eq x y n Heq). rewrite (@open_var_b_eq n n (a_Var_f x) Logic.eq_refl).
      subst y. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_f_neq x y n Hne). exact (@open_var_f x y (a_Var_f x) n).
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA1 n x). rewrite (IHA2 n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb1 n x). rewrite (IHb2 n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_close : forall (t:tm) (x:tmvar),
  open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x t) (a_Var_f x) = t.
Proof.
  intros t x. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm, close_tm_wrt_tm.
  exact (open_close_rec t 0 x).
Qed.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)

Lemma close_var_b_lt : forall (m n:nat) (x:atom), (m < n)%nat ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b m.
Proof.
  intros m n x H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge]; [reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

Lemma close_var_b_ge : forall (m n:nat) (x:atom), (n <= m)%nat ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b (S m).
Proof.
  intros m n x H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge]; [lia|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma close_var_f_eq : forall (x y:atom) n, x = y ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  intros x y n H. subst y. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  match goal with |- context[if ?d then ?a else ?b] => destruct d as [e|ne] end.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma close_var_f_neq : forall (x y:atom) n, x <> y ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof.
  intros x y n H. cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  match goal with |- context[if ?d then ?a else ?b] => destruct d as [e|ne] end.
  - exfalso; apply H; exact e.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_lt : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), (m < n)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b m.
Proof.
  intros m n u H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m n) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [reflexivity|lia|lia].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_eq : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), m = n ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = u.
Proof.
  intros m n u H. subst n. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m m) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [lia|reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_b_gt : forall (m n:nat) (u:tm), (n < m)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_b m) = a_Var_b (m - 1).
Proof.
  intros m n u H. simpl.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m n) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; [lia|lia|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma open_var_f : forall (x y:atom) (u:tm) n,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n u (a_Var_f y) = a_Var_f y.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma open_close_rec : forall (t:tm) n x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n x t) = t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros n x.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHb (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_lt m n x Hlt). rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m n (a_Var_f x) Hlt). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_ge m n x Hge).
      assert (HnSm : (n < S m)%nat) by lia.
      rewrite (@open_var_b_gt (S m) n (a_Var_f x) HnSm).
      replace (S m - 1) with m by lia. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (x = y)) as [Heq|Hne].
    + rewrite (@close_var_f_eq x y n Heq). rewrite (@open_var_b_eq n n (a_Var_f x) Logic.eq_refl).
      subst y. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_f_neq x y n Hne). exact (@open_var_f x y (a_Var_f x) n).
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA1 n x). rewrite (IHA2 n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb1 n x). rewrite (IHb2 n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n x). rewrite (IHB (S n) x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). rewrite (IHb n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_close : forall (t:tm) (x:tmvar),
  open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x t) (a_Var_f x) = t.
Proof.
  intros t x. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm, close_tm_wrt_tm.
  exact (open_close_rec t 0 x).
Qed.

Require Import Qual.typing.
From Stdlib Require Import Classical.
From Stdlib Require Import Sorting.Permutation.
Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------------- locally closed characterization ---------------- *)

Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs psi A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Type s => True
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => lc_at k A1 /\ lc_at k A2
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case psi a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair psi a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma psi A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a psi b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 psi a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 psi a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall t j z,
  lc_at j (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec j (a_Var_f z) t) <-> lc_at (S j) t.
Proof.

  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[H|H]|H]; simpl; split; intros; lia.
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - exact (IHt j z).
  - split.
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj1 (IHt3 j z) H3).
    + intros [H1 [H2 H3]]. split; [|split].
      * exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2).
      * exact (proj2 (IHt3 j z) H3).
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 j z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 j z) H2) ].
  - split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
    [ exact (proj1 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj1 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2)
    | exact (proj2 (IHt1 j z) H1) | exact (proj2 (IHt2 (S j) z) H2) ].

  - exact (IHt j z).

Qed.

Fixpoint size_tm (t:tm) : nat :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (size_tm A + size_tm b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Sum A1 A2 => S (size_tm A1 + size_tm A2)
  | a_Inj1 a => S (size_tm a)

  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => S (size_tm a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => S (size_tm a)
  end.

Lemma size_tm_open_rec : forall t k z,
  size_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) t) = size_tm t.
Proof.
  intros t. induction t; simpl; intros k z; auto;
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 k z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 (S k) z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt k z); auto);
  try (rewrite (IHt1 k z), (IHt2 k z), (IHt3 k z); auto).
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H|H]|H]; auto.
Qed.

Proof. intros; apply size_tm_open_rec. Qed.

  pose proof (@canon_typing_spec Hhead nil psi v (a_Pi psi0 A B) Hv Ht) as H.

     lc_tm a ->

     lc_tm a ->

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Proof.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Common-reduct invariant for DefEq, and head-tag preservation.        *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition PJ (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) : Prop :=
  exists c, MultiPar P psi a c /\ MultiPar P psi b c.

Definition CPJ (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) : Prop :=
  exists c, CMultiPar P psi phi0 a c /\ CMultiPar P psi phi0 b c.

Lemma ValueType_ctag_some : forall a, ValueType a -> exists t, ctag a = Some t.
Proof.
  intros a H. inversion H; subst.
  - exists TType. reflexivity.
  - exists TTyUnit. reflexivity.
  - exists TPi. reflexivity.
  - exists TWSigma. reflexivity.
  - exists TSSigma. reflexivity.
  - exists TSum. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------------- CMultiPar basic algebra ---------------- *)

Lemma CMultiPar_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  CMultiPar P psi phi0 a b ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ MultiPar P psi a b) \/
  (lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ ~ (phi0 <= psi) /\ uniq P).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 p p0 a0 b0 i mp|P0 p p0 a0 b0 la lb n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [ exact la | split; [ exact lb | split; assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma CMultiPar_grade_r : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  CMultiPar P psi phi0 a b -> CGrade P psi phi0 b.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H. induction H as [P0 p p0 a0 a1 i mp | P0 p p0 a0 a1 la lb n u].
  - apply CG_Leq; [ exact i | exact (MultiPar_grade_r mp) ].
  - apply CG_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CMultiPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a,
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CMultiPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H.
  destruct (CGrade_cases H) as [[Hle Hg]|[Hlc Hnle]].
  - apply CMP_Leq; [ exact Hle | apply MP_Refl; exact Hg ].
  - apply CMP_Nleq; [ exact Hlc | exact Hlc | exact Hnle | exact (CGrade_uniq H) ].
Qed.

Lemma CMultiPar_app : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  CMultiPar P psi phi0 a b -> forall c, CMultiPar P psi phi0 b c ->
  CMultiPar P psi phi0 a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H. induction H as [P0 p p0 a0 a1 i mp | P0 p p0 a0 a1 la lb n u].
  - intros c H2.
    destruct (CMultiPar_cases H2) as [[j mp2]|[lc2 n2]].
    + apply CMP_Leq; [ exact i | apply (MultiPar_app mp mp2) ].
    + exfalso. apply n2. exact i.
  - intros c H2.
    destruct (CMultiPar_cases H2) as [[j _]|[lcb [lcc [n2 u2]]]].
    + exfalso. apply n. exact j.
    + apply CMP_Nleq; [ exact la | exact lcc | exact n | exact u ].
Qed.

Lemma CPar_CMultiPar : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  CPar P psi phi0 a b -> CMultiPar P psi phi0 a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 p p0 a0 b0 i par|P0 p p0 a0 b0 la lb n u].
  - apply CMP_Leq; [ exact i | apply Par_multipar; exact par ].
  - apply CMP_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_CMultiPar_le : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a b:tm),
  phi0 <= psi -> MultiPar P psi a b -> CMultiPar P psi phi0 a b.
Proof. intros. apply CMP_Leq; assumption. Qed.

(* ---------------- PJ is an equivalence relation ---------------- *)

Lemma PJ_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi a, Grade P psi a -> PJ P psi a a.
Proof. intros. exists a. split; apply MP_Refl; assumption. Qed.

Lemma PJ_sym : forall (P:econtext) psi a b, PJ P psi a b -> PJ P psi b a.
Proof. intros P psi a b [c [h1 h2]]. exists c. split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma PJ_trans : forall (P:econtext) psi a b, PJ P psi a b ->
  forall c, PJ P psi b c -> PJ P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b [d [had hbd]] c [e [hbe hce]].
  destruct (MultiPar_join hbd hbe) as [f [hdf hef]].
  exists f. split.
  - apply (MultiPar_app had hdf).
  - apply (MultiPar_app hce hef).
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Head-invariance of DefEq, via a common-parallel-reduct (PJ) layer.   *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma MultiPar_rename_mid : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm), MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) z gr x,
    P = C ++ (z,gr)::Q ->
    x `notin` dom (C ++ Q) ->
    MultiPar (C ++ (x,gr)::Q) psi
      (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z a) (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
