Lemma open_close_subst_gen : forall (E:tm) n z x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec n (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n z E)
  = subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros n z x.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHB (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHb (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m n) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_lt m n z Hlt). rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m n (a_Var_f x) Hlt).
      simpl. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_b_ge m n z Hge).
      assert (HnSm : (n < S m)%nat) by lia.
      rewrite (@open_var_b_gt (S m) n (a_Var_f x) HnSm).
      replace (S m - 1) with m by lia. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (y = z)) as [Hyz|Hyz].
    + subst y. rewrite (@close_var_f_eq z z n Logic.eq_refl).
      rewrite (@open_var_b_eq n n (a_Var_f x) Logic.eq_refl).
      rewrite subst_var_same. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@close_var_f_neq z y n (fun H => Hyz (Logic.eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (@open_var_f x y (a_Var_f x) n).
      rewrite (@subst_var_neq (a_Var_f x) z y (fun H => Hyz (Logic.eq_sym H))). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA1 n z x). rewrite (IHA2 n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb1 n z x). rewrite (IHb2 n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHB (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHA n z x). rewrite (IHB (S n) z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). rewrite (IHb n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite (IHa n z x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_var_gen : forall (B:tm) k z x,
  z `notin` fv_tm_tm B ->
  subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) B)
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) B.
Proof.
  intros B. induction B as
    [ | | psi A IHA B IHB | psi A IHA b IHb | a0 IHa psi b IHb | s | m | y
    | A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 | a0 IHa | a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa b IHb
    | psi A IHA B IHB | a0 IHa psi b IHb | psi a0 IHa | psi a0 IHa ];
    intros k z x Hfv.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HfvA HfvB].
    change (a_Pi psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f z) B))
            = a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f x) B)).
    rewrite (IHA k z x HfvA). rewrite (IHB (S k) z x HfvB). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [HfvA Hfvb].
    change (a_Abs psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f z) b))
            = a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f x) b)).
    rewrite (IHA k z x HfvA). rewrite (IHb (S k) z x Hfvb). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hfva Hfvb].
    change (a_App
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0)) psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) b))
            = a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x Hfva). rewrite (IHb k z x Hfvb). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
    + rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m k (a_Var_f z) Hlt).
      rewrite (@open_var_b_lt m k (a_Var_f x) Hlt). reflexivity.
    + subst m. rewrite (@open_var_b_eq k k (a_Var_f z) Logic.eq_refl).
      rewrite subst_var_same. rewrite (@open_var_b_eq k k (a_Var_f x) Logic.eq_refl). reflexivity.
    + assert (Hkm : (k < m)%nat) by lia.
      rewrite (@open_var_b_gt m k (a_Var_f z) Hkm).
      rewrite (@open_var_b_gt m k (a_Var_f x) Hkm). reflexivity.
  - assert (Hne : y <> z).
    { intro Heq. subst y. apply Hfv. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity. }
    rewrite (@open_var_f z y (a_Var_f z) k).
    rewrite (@subst_var_neq (a_Var_f x) z y (fun H => Hne (Logic.eq_sym H))).
    rewrite (@open_var_f x y (a_Var_f x) k). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_Sum
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A1))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A2))
            = a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A2)).
    rewrite (IHA1 k z x H1). rewrite (IHA2 k z x H2). reflexivity.
  - change (a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
            = a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x Hfv). reflexivity.
  - change (a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
            = a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x Hfv). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H23].
    apply notin_union_inv in H23. destruct H23 as [H2 H3].
    change (a_Case psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) b1))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) b2))
            = a_Case psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b2)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x H1). rewrite (IHb1 k z x H2). rewrite (IHb2 k z x H3). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_WSigma psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f z) B))
            = a_WSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f x) B)).
    rewrite (IHA k z x H1). rewrite (IHB (S k) z x H2). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_WPair
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0)) psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) b))
            = a_WPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x H1). rewrite (IHb k z x H2). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_LetPair psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f z) b))
            = a_LetPair psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f x) b)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x H1). rewrite (IHb (S k) z x H2). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_SSigma psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) A))
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f z) B))
            = a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) (a_Var_f x) B)).
    rewrite (IHA k z x H1). rewrite (IHB (S k) z x H2). reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_inv in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [H1 H2].
    change (a_SPair
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0)) psi
              (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) b))

    rewrite (IHa k z x H1). rewrite (IHb k z x H2). reflexivity.
  - change (a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
            = a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x Hfv). reflexivity.
  - change (a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f x) z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) a0))
            = a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a0)).
    rewrite (IHa k z x Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

Lemma CPar_refl_of : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a,
  lc_tm a -> uniq P -> (phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a) -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a Hlc Hu Hg.
  destruct (classic (phi0 <= psi)) as [Hle|Hnle].
  - apply CPar_Leq with (psi0:=phi0); [ exact Hle | apply Par_Refl; apply Hg; exact Hle ].
  - eapply CPar_Nleq; [ exact Hlc | exact Hlc | exact Hnle | exact Hu ].
Qed.

Lemma Par_dia_letpair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) psi psi0 a1 b1 a2 b2,
  Par P psi a1 a2 ->
  (forall c, Par P psi a1 c -> exists d, Par P psi a2 d /\ Par P psi c d) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> forall c,
      Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) c ->
      exists d, Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)) d /\
                Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi c d) ->
  forall c, Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) c ->
    exists d, Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2) d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  intros L P psi psi0 a1 b1 a2 b2 d IHd fam IHfam c H2.
  destruct (Par_letpair_cases H2) as
    [Heq | L2 a1' a2' b2' Heq Hpar HfamB | L2 a2' b2' Heq Hpar HfamB].
  - rewrite Heq. exists (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2). split.
    + apply Par_Refl. eapply Par_grade_r. eapply Par_LetPair; eassumption.
    + eapply Par_LetPair; eassumption.
  - destruct (IHd (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') Hpar) as [dWP [H1 H2p]].
    destruct (Par_wpair_inv H2p) as [c1 [c2 [HeqW HD]]].
    set (Ltot := L \u L2 \u fv_tm_tm b2 \u fv_tm_tm b2' \u dom P).
    destruct (atom_fresh Ltot) as [z Hz]. unfold Ltot in Hz.
    apply notin_union_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [HzL Hzr1].
    apply notin_union_inv in Hzr1. destruct Hzr1 as [HzL2 Hzr2].
  - intros L P1 psi1 psi0 A B g IH g0 IH0.
    eapply GEq_SSigma. exact IH. intros x Hx. apply IH0. exact Hx.
  - intros. eapply GEq_SPair; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Proj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Sum; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj1; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Inj2; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_Case; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TyUnit; eassumption.
  - intros. eapply GEq_TmUnit; eassumption.
  - intros P1 phi phi0 a Hle g IH. apply CEq_Leq; assumption.
  - intros. eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 a,
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. destruct H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [ assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption ].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_lc : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 ip Hg|P0 ph ph0 a0 l n u].
  - exact (Grade_lc Hg).
  - exact l. Qed.

Lemma CGrade_grade_of_le : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros P psi phi0 a H Hle. destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 ip Hg|P0 ph ph0 a0 l n u].
  - exact Hg.
  - exfalso. apply n. exact Hle. Qed.

Lemma le_bot : forall psi:grade, q_Bot <= psi.
Proof.
  intro psi. apply leq_meet. rewrite meet_comm. apply meet_Bot_r.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_cases : forall (P:econtext) psi phi0 (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a ->
  (phi0 <= psi /\ Grade P psi a) \/ (lc_tm a /\ ~ (phi0 <= psi)).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H.
  destruct H as [P0 ph ph0 a0 ip Hg|P0 ph ph0 a0 lc n u].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open_cgrade : forall (Q:econtext) psi psi0 (b:tm) (L:atoms) (s:tm),
  lc_tm s -> CGrade Q psi psi0 s ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::Q) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) ->
  Grade Q psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b s).
Proof.
  intros Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc Hc Hfam.
  destruct (CGrade_cases Hc) as [[Hle Hg]|[Hlc' Hnle]].
  - apply (@Grade_open Q psi psi0 b L s Hg Hfam).
  - apply (@Grade_open_lc Q psi psi0 b L s Hlc' Hnle Hfam).
Qed.

Lemma Grade_abs_fam : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (A b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) ->
  exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof. intros. inversion H. eexists. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma Grade_wpair_cgrade : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma In_dom_mem : forall (E:econtext) x g, In (x,g) E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|[y h] E IH]; intros x g H; simpl in *.
  - destruct H.
  - destruct H as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply (IH x g Hin).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_binds_det : forall (E:econtext) x g1 g2,
  uniq E -> In (x,g1) E -> In (x,g2) E -> g1 = g2.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|[y h] E IH]; intros x g1 g2 Hu H1 H2.
  - destruct H1.
  - inversion Hu as [|? ? ? HE Hnot]; subst.
    destruct H1 as [Heq1|Hin1]; destruct H2 as [Heq2|Hin2].
    + inversion Heq1; subst; inversion Heq2; subst; reflexivity.
    + inversion Heq1. subst. exfalso. apply Hnot. apply (In_dom_mem E x g2 Hin2).
    + inversion Heq2. subst. exfalso. apply Hnot. apply (In_dom_mem E x g1 Hin1).
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ---------------- relabelling grades of an econtext ---------------- *)

Definition grade_rel (psi:grade) (P P':econtext) : Prop :=
  dom P [=] dom P' /\
  uniq P /\ uniq P' /\
  (forall x g g', binds x g P -> binds x g' P' ->
     g = g' \/ (g <= psi /\ g' <= psi)).

Lemma grade_rel_cons_same : forall psi (P P':econtext) x g,
  grade_rel psi P P' -> x `notin` dom P -> x `notin` dom P' ->
  grade_rel psi ((x,g)::P) ((x,g)::P').
Proof.
  intros psi P P' x g Hr Hx Hx'. destruct Hr as [Hdom [Hu [Hu' Hrel]]].
  split.
  - simpl. rewrite Hdom. reflexivity.
  - split.
    + apply uniq_cons; [ exact Hu | exact Hx ].
    + split.
      * apply uniq_cons; [ exact Hu' | exact Hx' ].
      * intros y g1 g2 Hb1 Hb2. simpl in Hb1, Hb2.
        destruct Hb1 as [Heq1|Hin1]; destruct Hb2 as [Heq2|Hin2].
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hg1 : g1 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hy2 : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq2)).
           assert (Hg2 : g2 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq2)).
           subst y. subst g1. subst g2. left. reflexivity.
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq1)).
           assert (Hg1 : g1 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq1)).
           subst y. subst g1. exfalso.
           assert (Hin : x `in` dom P').
           { exact (@In_dom_mem P' x g2 Hin2). }
           exact (Hx' Hin).
        -- assert (Hy : y = x) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@fst atom grade) Heq2)).
           assert (Hg2 : g2 = g) by (symmetry; exact (f_equal (@snd atom grade) Heq2)).
           subst y. subst g2. exfalso.
           assert (Hin : x `in` dom P).
           { exact (@In_dom_mem P x g1 Hin1). }
           exact (Hx Hin).
        -- exact (Hrel y g1 g2 Hin1 Hin2).
Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_dom : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> dom P [=] dom P'.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 H). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_uniq : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> uniq P.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 (proj2 H)). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_uniq' : forall psi (P P':econtext),
  grade_rel psi P P' -> uniq P'.
Proof. intros psi P P' H. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 H))). Qed.

Lemma grade_rel_binds : forall psi (P P':econtext) x g g',
  grade_rel psi P P' -> binds x g P -> binds x g' P' ->
  g = g' \/ (g <= psi /\ g' <= psi).
Proof. intros psi P P' x g g' H. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 H)) x g g'). Qed.
Lemma Grade_relabel_mut : forall (P:econtext) psi (a:tm), Grade P psi a ->
  forall P', grade_rel psi P P' -> Grade P' psi a.

Lemma MultiPar_subst_same : forall (P:econtext) psi (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall (C Q:econtext) x gx u,
    P = C ++ (x,gx)::Q ->
    gx <= psi ->
    Grade (C ++ Q) psi u ->
    MultiPar (C ++ Q) psi (subst_tm_tm u x a) (subst_tm_tm u x b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  induction H as [P0 psi0 a0 g | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH].
  - intros C Q x gx u Heq Hle Hu. subst P0.
    apply MP_Refl.
    exact (@Grade_subst_mid (C++(x,gx)::Q) psi0 a0 g C Q x gx u Logic.eq_refl Hu).
  - intros C Q x gx u Heq Hle Hu. subst P0.
    assert (Hcp : CPar (C ++ Q) psi0 gx u u).
    { apply CPar_Leq; [ exact Hle | apply Par_Refl; exact Hu ]. }
    refine (@MP_Step (C++Q) psi0
              (subst_tm_tm u x a0) (subst_tm_tm u x a1) (subst_tm_tm u x b0) _ _).
    + exact (@Par_subst_var (C++(x,gx)::Q) psi0 a0 a1 p C Q x gx u u Logic.eq_refl Hcp).
    + apply IH; [ reflexivity | exact Hle | exact Hu ].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_open_arg : forall (P:econtext) psi g (B:tm) (L:atoms) (u v:tm),
  g <= psi ->
  Grade P psi u ->
  MultiPar P psi u v ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B u) (open_tm_wrt_tm B v).
Proof.
  intros P psi g B L u v Hle Hu Huv. revert Hu.
  induction Huv as [P0 psi0 a0 ga | P0 psi0 a0 a1 b0 p mp IH]; intros Hu.
  - apply MP_Refl.
    exact (@Grade_open P0 psi0 g B L a0 Hu Hfam).
  - refine (@MP_Step P0 psi0
              (open_tm_wrt_tm B a0) (open_tm_wrt_tm B a1)
              (open_tm_wrt_tm B b0) _ _).
    + apply (@Par_open P0 psi0 g B B L a0 a1).
      * intros x Hx. apply Par_Refl. apply Hfam. exact Hx.
      * apply CPar_Leq; [ exact Hle | exact p ].
    + apply IH. exact (Par_grade_r p).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_open_same : forall (P:econtext) psi g (b1 b2:tm) (L:atoms) u,
  g <= psi ->
  Grade P psi u ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> MultiPar ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 u).
Proof.
  intros P psi g b1 b2 L u Hle Hu Hfam.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom P \u fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) as [x Hx].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL Hxrest].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hxrest. destruct Hxrest as [HxP Hxrest].
  apply notin_union_inv in Hxrest. destruct Hxrest as [Hxfv1 Hxfv2].
  pose proof (@MultiPar_subst_same ((x,g)::P) psi
                (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))
                (Hfam x HxL) nil P x g u Logic.eq_refl Hle Hu) as Hsub.
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b1 x u Hxfv1) in Hsub.
  rewrite (@subst_open_id b2 x u Hxfv2) in Hsub.
  exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_open_both : forall (P:econtext) psi g (b1 b2:tm) (L:atoms) u v,
  g <= psi ->
  Grade P psi u ->
  MultiPar P psi u v ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> MultiPar ((x,g)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 v).
Proof.
  intros P psi g b1 b2 L u v Hle Hu Huv Hfam.
  assert (Hs : MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 u)).
  { exact (@MultiPar_open_same P psi g b1 b2 L u Hle Hu Hfam). }
  assert (Ha : MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 u) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 v)).
  { apply (@MultiPar_open_arg P psi g b2 L u v Hle Hu Huv).
    intros x Hx. exact (MultiPar_grade_r (Hfam x Hx)). }
  exact (MultiPar_app Hs Ha).
Qed.
